Our core innovation contains a two-stage caching strategy: an offline timestep profiling analysis that identifies redundant timesteps for cache reuse, followed by an adaptive layer-wise caching strategy that combines input stability with importance of each Transformer layer to selectively cache stable Attention and MLP submodules. Extensive experiments on mainstream open-source DiT models validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving significant acceleration while maintaining high fidelity to the uncached output, with up to a 4.18x acceleration on HunyuanVideo.

</details>


### [314] [D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11371)
*Hong Nie,Zhangchi Gao,Jun Yu,Bo Wang,Jianqing Sun,Shengping Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种能预测草稿树节点验证价值、并随请求负载动态调整验证规模的方法，在多种负载下显著加速推测解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块扩散草稿模型可一次生成多个候选词元，利用这些候选构建草稿树有望提高推测解码的接受长度。但目标模型验证树中每个节点都占用计算资源；并发请求较多时，收益低的分支会挤占其他请求的验证容量。既有方法通常按草稿概率或固定预算选节点，因而始终保留草稿模型排序靠前的节点，无法针对不同请求和解码轮次判断哪些节点真正值得验证。

Method: 提出一种学习草稿树节点验证价值的方法。该方法使用一个仅含少量参数的树规模预测头，根据草稿状态、候选节点表示及其草稿对数概率，预测候选节点在给定条件下的存活概率。沿父节点链累乘预测分数并进行阈值筛选，得到满足祖先闭合约束、大小可随请求和解码轮次变化的子树。预测头在冻结的草稿模型上使用完整候选树的条件标签训练；可选的联合训练模式还会引导草稿模型偏向保留的参考路径。服务时，低负载下验证整棵树；高负载下则依据预测存活率分配全批次节点预算，并使预算适配目标模型矩阵乘法的计算分块。保留的树通过一次带祖先掩码的目标模型前向计算完成验证，树构建、剪枝与调度均在图形处理器上执行，并与主机侧工作重叠。

Result: 在六种视觉语言验证模型和十七个文本及多模态基准上，该方法在七十二种负载设置中的七十种取得最快速度。单请求时，相较自回归解码加速三点二至四倍；六十四个并发请求时加速一点三至一点八倍，而固定预算树方法此时甚至慢于自回归解码。在随时间变化的请求到达轨迹中，该方法在每个到达阶段的端到端平均延迟均最低。

Conclusion: 研究表明，依据预测的节点存活价值动态选择验证节点，比固定预算或单纯依赖草稿概率排序更适合并发服务。结合负载感知的批次预算、祖先约束剪枝及并行调度，该方法能够在多种负载下提升推测解码速度，并降低变化负载中的端到端延迟。

Abstract: Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round. The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

</details>


### [315] [Self-Supervised Collapse Prevention with Score-Based Entropy Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11379)
*Adarsh Kappiyath,Silpa Vadakkeeveetil Sreelatha,Xiatian Zhu,Yann LeCun,Lu Yin,Amir Bar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于熵正则化的自监督表征学习框架，通过潜在空间评分模型维持表征多样性，并在测试时改善受扰表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型中的基于评分的目标已广泛用于生成建模，但其在自监督表征学习中的潜力尚未充分探索。现有自监督训练可能出现表征坍塌，因此需要一种能促进表征多样性、又无需显式计算概率密度的方法。

Method: 框架联合训练编码器与潜在评分模型，利用评分信号正则化潜在分布，避免表征坍塌。目标函数受互信息下界启发，将不同视图的对齐与平滑边缘熵最大化结合，并借助评分模型优化边缘熵而不显式评估密度。测试时还可用同一评分模型，将受扰表征引导回训练时的潜在分布。

Result: 在千类图像基准上，采用大型视觉变换器时，线性探测准确率达到百分之七十五点五七。跨多种架构的测试时评分引导适应，在常见图像扰动基准上使平均相对准确率提升约百分之五。

Conclusion: 潜在评分模型不仅能作为自监督训练中的多样性正则信号，也能用于测试时表征修正。实验表明，该方法兼具有竞争力的表征质量与对图像扰动的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated the effectiveness of score-based objectives for generative modeling, yet their potential for self-supervised representation learning remains underexplored. We introduce Entropy-Based Regularization (EBReg), a framework that uses latent score estimation to regularize the latent distribution during self-supervised training. EBReg jointly learns an encoder and a latent score model, and utilizes the learned score to provide a diversity-preserving signal that prevents representational collapse. Motivated by a mutual-information lower bound, we formulate the objective as view alignment with smoothed marginal entropy maximization and optimize the marginal entropy without explicit density evaluation. The same score model can additionally be used at test time to refine corrupted representations toward the training latent distribution. Empirically, EBReg learns competitive representations on ImageNet-1K, achieving 75.57% linear-probe accuracy with ViT-L. Across diverse architectures, score-guided test-time adaptation further improves robustness on ImageNet-C, yielding an average relative accuracy gain of approximately 5%.

</details>


### [316] [The comparison of density estimation for transfer learning in Banach, Hilbert, Euclidean spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11382)
*Maryam Alsadat Kazemian,Azam Bastanfard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于流形几何与一范数密度正则化的领域迁移方法，以总变差距离对齐不同领域的数据分布；实验显示其优于对应的二范数版本及多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有领域适应方法常假设特征处于欧几里得空间或希尔伯特空间，并用对称的平方差异衡量分布差异。平方误差会放大分布尾部的偏差，使少数异常区域过度影响对齐效果。论文旨在摆脱这种几何与度量限制，更稳健地处理目标标签或计算资源有限时的跨领域学习问题。

Method: 论文提出班纳赫流形迁移学习方法：一方面，将特征视为位于测地流形上，而非平坦欧几里得空间中的点；另一方面，以一范数约束密度匹配。根据舍费定理，最小化该一范数差异等价于缩小总变差距离。总变差距离有界，并对样本空间各区域一视同仁，从而避免平方差异对尾部偏差的过度强调。

Result: 在手写数字迁移、物体图像识别及办公场景图像迁移任务中，方法均取得稳定提升。一范数版本在所有任务上都优于结构相同的二范数消融版本；例如，从美国邮政手写数字迁移到手写数字数据集时，准确率为百分之九十二点四四，对比二范数版本的百分之八十九点八零。在十二组办公场景迁移任务中，平均准确率比最强基线高三点六八个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究表明，结合非希尔伯特空间的流形特征表示与一范数总变差对齐，能够改善领域间分布匹配，并在多个迁移任务中带来一致收益。该结果支持将几何结构和差异度量共同纳入领域适应设计；不过，摘要未提供具体复杂度、统计显著性或适用范围方面的细节。

Abstract: Domain adaptation or DA methods are indispensable when target labels or computational resources are scarce, yet the domain kernel density and subspace alignment approaches completely assume a Hilbertian geometry.
  They measure distributional discrepancy with symmetric L2 divergences over Euclidean feature spaces or reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS). This preprint summarizes the manuscript Non-Hilbertian Domain Adaptation. Total Variation Alignment via L1 Density Regularization on Feature Manifolds, which proposes Banach Manifold Transfer Learning or BMTL. BMTL makes two coupled design decisions. The first one is that features are embedded on a geodesic manifold rather than treated as points of a flat Euclidean space, and the second one is that the density matching regularizer is formulated in an L1 Banach norm, whose minimization is equivalent, by Scheffe's theorem, to contracting the Total Variation or TV distance between domain densities, a bounded metric that weights all regions of the sample space uniformly. The L2 formulation, by contrast, squares deviations and therefore amplifies errors in the tails, over emphasizing density outliers that do not reflect meaningful distributional shift. Experiments on MNIST-USPS, COIL20, and Office+Caltech10 show consistent gains; the L1 variant beats an otherwise identical L2 ablation on every task, for example 92.44% vs. 89.80% on USPS->MNIST and surpasses the strongest baseline DMDA by +3.68% on average over twelve Office+Caltech transfers. This document situates the contribution with an explicit comparison of Euclidean, Hilbert, and Banach geometries.

</details>


### [317] [Orthogonal Updates for the Win: Towards Accelerated Adaptive Minimax Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11387)
*Zhiwei Zhai,Xinyu Wang,Wenjing Yan,Lei Ding,Ying-Jun Angela Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出适用于极小极大优化的正交更新框架，并设计自适应步长与方差缩减机制，以提升训练稳定性和收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单循环极小极大优化中的原始变量与对偶变量紧密耦合，标准随机梯度更新容易出现不稳定和振荡，且性能对步长设置十分敏感。正交化更新虽能缓解更新方向的各向异性，却会改变优化几何，使原始与对偶步长的协调更加困难。

Method: 作者提出正交更新框架，通过沿正交化方向进行更新，降低更新的各向异性；在此基础上提出自适应随机梯度下降上升方法，根据累积梯度范数调整步长，从而平衡耦合的原始与对偶变量更新，并减少对问题相关参数调节的依赖。进一步提出结合专门设计的方差缩减机制的改进方法。

Result: 理论分析表明，在非凸—强凹极小极大问题中，自适应方法达到最优阶为迭代次数负四分之一次方的收敛速率；加入方差缩减后，改进方法达到迭代次数负三分之一次方的更快收敛速率。实验结果显示，所提方法相较现有极小极大优化方法具有有竞争力的表现。

Conclusion: 该研究将正交更新与梯度范数驱动的自适应步长相结合，针对极小极大优化中的稳定性和步长协调难题提出了有效方案，并通过方差缩减进一步提升收敛速度。

Abstract: Single-loop minimax methods are appealing for modern machine learning, but standard stochastic gradient updates can be unstable and oscillatory under tightly coupled primal-dual dynamics, making performance notoriously sensitive to stepsizes. To fundamentally improve stability, we develop an orthogonal update framework tailored to minimax optimization, which applies updates along orthogonalized directions to reduce update anisotropy. However, orthogonalization reshapes the optimization geometry and makes coordinating primal-dual stepsizes even more delicate. To overcome this challenge, we develop AdaSGDA, which equips orthogonal updates with an adaptive stepsize rule driven by accumulated gradient norms. This mechanism automatically balances coupled primal-dual progress under orthogonalization, yielding an effectively parameter-free method for nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization. We prove that AdaSGDA avoids problem-dependent tuning while attaining the state-of-the-art $\mathcal{O}\left(T^{-1/4}\right)$ convergence rate. We further propose AdaSGDA-VR, which incorporates a carefully designed variance reduction scheme and achieves the faster $\mathcal{O}\left(T^{-1/3}\right)$ rate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our methods deliver competitive performance compared to existing minimax optimization methods.

</details>


### [318] [Decomposing Earth Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11398)
*Vitus Benson,Fanny Yang,Markus Reichstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出用稀疏自编码器拆解地球观测模型的嵌入表示，并设计适用于卫星像素的评估方案。结果表明，稀疏特征更易与少量概念对应、保留更多细尺度信息；但只有学习得到的字典能准确重建嵌入，应用验证目前仍不够可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测基础模型生成的全球米级嵌入，已用于农业、生态和水文等领域，但其各维度混合了不同物理概念，难以解释，也不易评估稳健性。现有面向大语言模型解释的评判方法不适用于卫星像素，且未充分考虑空间自相关，因此需要一种可解释性分解方法及相应评估协议。

Method: 研究采用稀疏自编码器，将嵌入分解为过完备字典中的稀疏、近似单义特征，并提出专门评估协议，从等稀疏度下的重建质量、与参考概念的对应程度、空间尺度三个方面评分。比较基线包括解码器固定为随机字典的自编码器。研究还将稀疏特征用于发现土地覆盖子概念，以及通过适用范围估计检测分布外像素。

Result: 在阿尔法地球和泰瑟拉嵌入上，训练得到的稀疏自编码器在匹配稀疏度时，重建效果优于所有基线。以阿尔法地球为例，百分之八十八的稀疏特征至多对应二十组参考概念中的一组，且多数不对应任何一组；原始嵌入维度的对应概念数中位数则为十二组。批次取前若干项和嵌套式方法的特征方差有百分之二十三至三十二分布在六百四十米范围内，而基线为百分之九。固定随机解码器也呈现概念对应较少、细尺度信息较多的特征，说明这两项性质主要来自稀疏性；但其重建能力较差，阿尔法地球上训练所得自编码器未解释的方差约少八倍。两项应用展示了稀疏特征的潜力，但尚不足以支持可靠的实际使用。

Conclusion: 稀疏自编码器为检查地球观测嵌入提供了有前景的途径：稀疏性有助于获得更局部、更易对应概念的特征，而学习字典对于忠实重建至关重要。不过，特征解释及下游应用的可靠性仍需提升；该研究是迈向可检查地球观测模型的一步，而非成熟的实用方案。

Abstract: Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

</details>


### [319] [Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11423)
*Zhijie Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文针对有限时域马尔可夫决策过程的离线策略优化，提出一种逐层仅需一次凸回归的算法；在覆盖与线性可实现性条件下，样本复杂度关于精度为近乎平方反比，且对特征系数上界仅呈对数级计算依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线策略优化只能利用未知行为策略生成的完整轨迹。既有方法可能需要很高精度地近似经验协方差矩阵，导致计算负担随系数上界显著增加。论文旨在降低样本与计算成本，同时建立足以保障策略性能的逐点预测置信度，并处理有限精度数值实现问题。

Method: 假设每个确定性马尔可夫策略的动作价值函数都由已知特征线性表示，且系数范数不超过给定上界；在所有策略占用覆盖条件下，算法对每一层执行一次凸回归，并使用同一个一致的马尔可夫见证策略生成停止回报目标。通过共享参考设计和有界预测约束，将快速截断回归误差转化为原始线性预测的逐点置信界；再以截断杠杆值控制性能损失，避免将经验协方差逼近到系数上界平方倒数的精度。将置信半径向上取整，可保留见证策略的一致性，并支持有理数输入下的多项式时间位级实现。

Result: 算法的样本复杂度关于目标精度为近乎 O(ε⁻²)，计算复杂度关于系数范数上界呈 log(2+B) 的多项式依赖。保证适用于任意固定初始状态分布，且可实现性与覆盖条件只需对确定性策略检验。论文还给出协方差覆盖变体，在均匀近似可实现性下具有关于 B 的多项式依赖；两动作下界表明，精度指数 2 在一般情形中不可改进。

Conclusion: 该工作通过统一的见证策略目标、共享参考设计与截断杠杆控制，构造了样本高效且可计算的离线策略优化方法，并使其数值实现具备严格保证。其下界进一步说明，算法在精度上的平方反比样本依赖具有必要性。

Abstract: We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most $B$. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in $\log(2+B)$. The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale $B^{-2}$. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on $B$. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent $2$ is necessary.

</details>


### [320] [CHANNELS4WORLD: An Environment-Scale Dataset for Wireless Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11428)
*Joonkyu Jang,Hyung-Joo Moon,Kwang Soon Kim,Seong-Lyun Kim,Jakob Hoydis,Robert W. Heath,,Chan-Byoung Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一个以场景为中心的大规模户外无线信道数据集及其程序化生成方法，旨在提升无线基础模型跨部署环境的泛化研究能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线基础模型需要在多样环境中预训练，以学习可复用表示；但现有无线数据集常集中于少数地点的密集采样，环境覆盖面不足，且难以将环境多样性与单一场景内的观测密度分别控制。

Method: 构建包含十万个不同户外射频场景的数据集。每个场景关联生成环境、射频材料配置、三十二个基站位置和一万六千三百八十四个用户设备位置，并提供三点五与七吉赫频段下对齐的可变长度多径及有序传播交互记录。数据集共涵盖约五百二十四点三亿个基站—用户设备物理位置对、约一千零四十八点六亿次分频段评估，打包数据量为二十九点一四太字节。研究还提供不同规模的预定义子集、组件独立访问方式，以及按场景划分的九比一训练测试集；并分析不同生成配置下的环境形态、射频材料和收发器布局，以及传播效应和路径保留策略。

Result: 分析显示，绕射会显著影响保留链路的可用性及多径结构；路径保留策略则大幅降低存储需求，同时对所表示的总体功率损失较小。在训练暴露量匹配时，使用更多样场景集合训练的模型在未见场景上表现更好；但控制每个训练轮次样本量后，场景数量本身并不足以解释全部性能提升。

Conclusion: 该工作通过显式组织并控制环境多样性与场景内采样密度，为无线基础模型的训练和评测提供了大规模、跨频段且场景对齐的数据基础，有助于研究模型在不同部署环境中的泛化能力。

Abstract: Wireless foundation models learn reusable representations across tasks, configurations, and deployment environments. Their pretraining requires environmental breadth, yet wireless datasets often sample few sites densely. We introduce Channels4World, a scene-centered dataset of 100,000 distinct outdoor RF scenes and a procedural method for generating them. Each scene links a generated environment and RF material assignments to 32 base-station (BS) positions, 16,384 UE positions, and aligned variable-length multipath and ordered interaction records at 3.5 and 7~GHz. The corpus comprises 52.43 billion physical BS-UE pairs, 104.86 billion frequency-specific evaluations, and a 29.14-TB packaged payload. Scene identity aligns geometry, placements, channels, and interactions across frequencies, allowing environmental breadth and within-scene observation density to vary independently. The public release offers predefined subsets at multiple scales and separate access to corpus components. A deterministic 90K/10K scene-level train-test split keeps both frequencies and all scene components together. We characterize morphology, RF materials, and transceiver placement across three generation profiles. Controlled propagation and path-retention analyses show that diffraction materially affects retained-link availability and multipath structure, while the retention policy reduces storage substantially with little loss in represented aggregate power. Under matched training exposure, models trained on broader scene collections perform better on held-out scenes, although an equal-episode control shows that scene count alone cannot explain the gain. By making environmental breadth explicit and controllable, Channels4World supports the development and evaluation of wireless foundation models for generalization across deployment environments.

</details>


### [321] [Learning to Rank Propagators in Constraint Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11447)
*Matija Lojović,Mladen Nikolić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究从问题静态特征中学习实例相关的传播器优先级。在698个困难测试实例上，相比求解器默认优先级，学习方法多解决20个实例，中位运行时间降低27.93%，惩罚运行时间总量降低12.65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程求解器中传播器的执行顺序会显著影响求解效率，但现有优先级通常依赖固定的人工启发式，难以适应不同实例。与此同时，优先级方案的优劣只能通过求解器运行时间衡量，单个传播器理想的优先级并没有直接标注，因此需要一种能够从实例特征中学习排序的方法。

Method: 将传播器优先级学习建模为学习排序问题。模型利用自注意力机制，根据实例的静态特征为其中的传播器联合打分；训练偏好由随机传播器优先级方案对应的求解器运行时间推导，并采用基于普莱克特—卢斯分布的排序目标进行训练。求解开始前，再将预测排序映射为求解器支持的离散优先级；不修改传播过程或搜索过程。

Result: 在按问题类别筛选出的698个困难测试实例上，学习优先级将解决实例数从634个提升至654个，中位运行时间降低27.93%，惩罚运行时间总量降低12.65%。效果因问题类别而异；进一步采用在学习优先级与默认优先级之间进行选择的简单策略后，解决实例数还能继续增加。

Conclusion: 传播器排序是影响约束编程求解性能的重要因素。从静态特征学习实例相关的优先级具有提升求解效率的潜力，尤其适用于困难实例。研究也表明，按问题类别或实例情况选择是否采用学习结果，可能比对所有实例一概使用同一优先级方案更有效。

Abstract: The order in which propagators are executed can substantially affect the performance of constraint programming solvers, yet propagator priorities are typically determined by fixed, manually designed heuristics. In this work, we explore learning instance-dependent propagator priorities from static problem features. We formulate the task as a learning-to-rank problem, addressing the challenge that the quality of a priority assignment can be measured through solver runtime, while the desired priorities of individual propagators are not directly observable. A self-attention-based model jointly scores the propagators present in an instance and is trained using pairwise preferences derived from solver runtimes measured under randomized propagator priority assignments, with a Plackett-Luce-based ranking objective. Predicted rankings are mapped to the discrete priority levels of the Choco solver before search begins, without modifying its propagation or search procedures. We evaluate the approach on XCSP3 instances and demonstrate that propagator ordering can have a substantial impact on solving time. On a test set of 698 instances, picked out as most difficult by problem class, the learned priorities increase the number of solved instances from 634 to 654, reduce median solver runtime by 27.93%, and reduce aggregate penalized runtime (PAR1) by 12.65% compared with Choco's default priorities. We further observe that improvements vary across problem classes and show that a simple policy selecting between learned and default priorities further increases the number of solved instances. These results demonstrate the potential of learning instance-dependent propagator priorities to improve constraint programming performance, particularly on difficult instances.

</details>


### [322] [How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11450)
*Cong Yu,Ziting Wang,Songlin Jiang,Sitong Zhang,Chengliang Chai,Youhe Jiang,Eiko Yoneki,Tuo Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究训练与推理不一致对在策略蒸馏的影响，发现该方法能容忍一定程度的不一致，但超过模型相关的经验阈值后训练质量会下降；据此提出轻量筛查方案，并展示低精度推理与异步生成可显著提升效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在策略蒸馏依赖学生模型生成自身回答，再由固定教师指导训练。生成过程成本较高，因此系统常采用量化推理和异步生成；但这些做法会使生成回答所用的模型状态与实际训练模型不一致。此类不一致可能导致强化学习不稳定，而它对在策略蒸馏的影响尚不明确。论文旨在厘清其可容忍程度、影响来源及系统层面的利用方式。

Method: 作者将不同来源的不一致统一到同一度量尺度，考察三个学生—教师模型组合中的量化影响，并在其中一个组合上进一步测试权重滞后和人为注入噪声。通过受控实验比较在策略蒸馏与强化学习方法的稳定性，并分析量化对不同模型及网络层的影响。最后提出轻量级准入检查，用经过校准的不一致预算筛查候选生成配置，无需为每种配置完整运行训练。

Result: 实验显示，在策略蒸馏可承受相当程度的不一致而基本不损害训练质量，但不一致过高时性能会下降，且可容忍范围因模型而异。量化引入的不一致及其质量代价同样依赖模型，部分网络层对精度降低尤其敏感。在受控对比中，即使某些生成配置会使强化学习方法不稳定，在策略蒸馏仍保持稳定。权重噪声还会改变生成时到达的前缀，因此仅做逐词修正无法消除这类误差。针对具体模型设计的八位浮点方案在保持训练质量的同时，使键值缓存可容纳的令牌数至少达到脑浮点方案的1.93倍；结合异步生成后，达到相同训练质量所需时间比同步脑浮点训练缩短至原来的约1/1.62。

Conclusion: 训练与推理不一致并非必然破坏在策略蒸馏，但存在依赖模型的经验预算，超出后会损害训练质量。系统设计应针对具体模型评估量化及其他不一致来源，并通过轻量准入检查筛选配置。经过模型适配的低精度推理与异步生成能够在维持训练效果的基础上提升资源利用率和训练速度。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

</details>


### [323] [MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11457)
*Sunny Gupta,Raja Viswanadha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种考虑优化器状态的分析框架，说明动量可能改变不同时间相关差分隐私噪声机制的效用排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间相关噪声能够提升差分隐私优化的效用，但现有机制通常只依据工作负载结构、学习率安排或局部曲率等部分信息进行设计和评估。论文关注一个被忽视的问题：优化器持续保留的状态是否会影响隐私噪声的传播，并进而改变机制优劣。

Method: 提出动量优化器状态感知的差分隐私分析框架，刻画时间相关隐私噪声在基于动量的优化过程中的传播。对于局部二次目标，框架通过优化器传递算子表达隐私噪声导致的最终损失；该算子联合纳入曲率、学习率安排、动量和噪声的时间协方差。已有的曲率感知二次判据可由该框架在零动量、恒定学习率的特殊情形下精确恢复。

Result: 在保持曲率、学习率安排、隐私校准方式及候选机制不变时，仅改变动量就会导致不同噪声机制的效用排序发生反转。类似影响也出现在逐样本裁剪的私有逻辑回归中；但在论文考察的神经网络场景下，相关现象尚未得到明确结论。

Conclusion: 优化器状态是评估时间相关差分隐私噪声时具有实际决策影响、但以往研究考虑不足的因素。机制比较应将动量等状态与曲率、学习率安排及噪声相关性一并纳入分析。

Abstract: Temporally correlated noise can substantially improve the utility of differentially private optimization, yet candidate mechanisms are commonly designed or evaluated using only partial information about the optimization process, such as workload structure, learning-rate schedules, or local curvature. We study whether persistent optimizer state provides additional information that can change the relative utility of privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms.
  We introduce MOMENT-DP, an optimizer-state-aware framework that models how temporally correlated privacy noise propagates through momentum-based optimization. For locally quadratic objectives, MOMENT-DP expresses privacy-induced final loss through an optimizer transfer operator that jointly captures curvature, learning-rate scheduling, momentum, and temporal noise covariance. NoiseCurve's curvature-aware quadratic criterion is recovered exactly as the zero-momentum, constant-learning-rate special case.
  Changing only momentum while holding curvature, schedule, privacy calibration, and candidate mechanisms fixed induces genuine mechanism-ranking reversals. The effect persists outside exact quadratic dynamics in per-example-clipped private logistic regression, while remaining unresolved in the neural regime we study. These results establish optimizer state as an under-modeled, decision-relevant axis in evaluating temporally correlated privacy noise.

</details>


### [324] [One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11481)
*Shenghong Cai,Yiqun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种单轮联邦层次聚类框架，通过机构端发送原型、服务器端进行多粒度竞争学习，在减少通信与隐私风险的同时尽可能保留跨机构的全局分布结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机构生物医学数据分散在不同数据孤岛中，各机构的数据分布粒度不一，甚至具有复杂的嵌套结构。传统层次聚类需要繁琐的递归计算，开销较大，也可能增加隐私泄露风险；而单向、低通信量的协作方式又容易造成信息损失。因此，需要一种兼顾计算效率、隐私保护和全局聚类质量的方法。

Method: 提出单轮联邦层次聚类框架：各机构在本地探索数据分布，并仅向服务器单向传输聚类原型；服务器利用多粒度竞争学习机制融合各机构生成的簇单元，以补偿原型传输造成的信息损失，并挖掘跨机构的全局分布拓扑。

Result: 摘要称，该框架能够高效探索不同机构的复杂簇分布。公开数据集上的大量实验表明，与先进方法相比，它在聚类稳健性、隐私保护和计算效率之间取得了更好的综合表现。

Conclusion: 通过将本地分布探索与服务器端原型融合相结合，并以多粒度竞争学习增强有限通信下的信息利用，该方法为隐私敏感的多机构聚类提供了一种高效方案。摘要未提供具体数据集、指标或性能提升幅度，因此其优势程度仍需结合论文正文中的实验结果评估。

Abstract: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [325] [Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11493)
*Lydia T. Liu,Kara Schechtman,Pengyi Shi,Angela Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，考虑床位容量的出院策略可改善再入院风险估计，并缓解由结果数据删失造成的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院常依据再入院风险预测来决定患者何时出院，但弱势群体可能因历史数据不足或既往出院决策而缺少充分的结局观察，产生删失偏差。若用有偏预测指导出院，新的训练数据又会延续这种偏差，形成循环。研究旨在寻找既能满足医院容量需求、又能改善风险估计与公平性的决策方式。

Method: 作者扩展了用于医院出院决策的排队型马尔可夫决策过程，将定期重新训练的再入院风险预测器纳入模型。核心策略是“出院至上限”策略：结合容量约束安排出院，使不同患者的住院时长和结局观察机会自然多样化，无须显式加入公平性约束。作者还证明，在模型设定正确的条件下，反复重新训练会收敛到无偏风险估计。

Result: 在合成实验及基于合作医院患者数据校准的模拟中，常见的风险阈值策略可能持续保留偏差；相比这类现行策略，出院至上限策略将学习误差降低了百分之二十四至百分之二十五。它还使按群体基线风险差异调整后的再入院成本差距降低了百分之三十八至百分之六十三。

Conclusion: 将床位容量纳入出院决策，不仅有助于运营管理，也能改变哪些患者的结局会被观察，从而减轻删失偏差。研究显示，出院至上限策略有望同时提升风险预测准确性并缓解部分公平性差距，但其理论保证依赖模型设定正确，实证结果也主要来自模拟。

Abstract: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.

</details>


### [326] [Regret without Optimal-Arm Feedback under Reward-Dependent Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11494)
*Zhong Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究奖励相关且可能无限长的反馈延迟，并且反馈不标明产生它的轮次的随机赌博机问题；提出平衡历史乐观算法及其改进，并给出延迟代价的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在延迟反馈的赌博机中，延迟可能取决于奖励，甚至没有有限上界；同时，反馈缺少轮次标记，使学习者难以判断哪些历史选择产生了当前观测。论文旨在厘清这类反馈机制下探索与等待的代价，并设计不依赖最优臂反馈的有效算法。

Method: 提出平衡历史乐观算法，通过平衡历史信息来处理无法对应到具体轮次的反馈。对任意介于零与一之间的参数，算法的延迟代价可由次优臂在特定分位水平处的延迟阈值控制，而无需收到最优臂的反馈。进一步提出由待处理反馈触发的平衡机制，在保留上述加权延迟界的同时，针对确定性奖励、唯一最优臂和固定有界延迟，达到历史贪心方法的探索系数。

Result: 理论下界表明，在对数级统计遗憾情形中，放宽分位水平所付出的代价按松弛量的平方倒数增长；当参数取边界值一时，最坏情形的极小极大遗憾为线性。另有一族臂数增长的问题表明，任何学习者的最坏情形遗憾至少为 Ω(G log K)，其中 G 是各次优臂的间隙与相应延迟截断值乘积的最大值。加权比较与实验还展示了共享等待何时有益，以及平衡探索所需的代价。

Conclusion: 在反馈延迟依赖奖励、可能无界且缺少轮次标记的环境中，算法性能由次优臂的间隙加权延迟阈值显著影响。平衡历史乐观及其待处理反馈触发版本能够在不依赖最优臂反馈的情况下控制延迟代价；与此同时，下界揭示了更强延迟保证所需付出的统计代价，以及臂数增长带来的不可避免遗憾。

Abstract: We study stochastic bandits with reward-dependent delays, possibly infinite, whose reports omit the originating round. For each $c\in[0,1)$, Balanced Historical Optimism (BHO) has a delay term controlled by the largest suboptimal-arm quantile at level $1-cΔ_i$, without requiring optimal-arm reports. Lower bounds give an inverse-square slack cost in the logarithmic statistical regime and linear minimax regret at $c=1$. A family with growing $K$ forces worst-case regret $Ω(G\log K)$ for every learner, where $G=\max_iΔ_i h_i$ is the largest gap-weighted suboptimal cutoff. Pending-triggered balance preserves BHO's weighted-cutoff bound for $c<1$ and attains the historical-greedy exploration coefficient with deterministic rewards, a unique optimum and fixed bounded delays. Gap-weighted comparisons and experiments show when shared waiting helps and what balanced exploration costs.

</details>


### [327] [JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11499)
*Xudong Wu,Guangchen Lan,Mingqi Yuan,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种联合强化学习框架，同时优化语言智能体的任务执行策略与可执行运行框架生成策略；在三个基准上优于所比较的方法，平均成功率为百分之七十点三。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体的表现取决于模型参数与运行框架，两者单独优化会受到另一方限制。朴素交替训练还会使模型与框架逐渐不兼容，干扰任务执行，甚至损害模型训练并导致性能下降。

Method: 提出联合训练框架，通过强化学习同时训练任务执行策略和可执行运行框架生成策略。该方法利用自身生成的轨迹学习任务执行与运行时改进，使模型和框架协同演进，并实现递归自我改进。

Result: 在具身交互、在线购物和数据库任务三个基准上，该方法优于所评估的仅优化模型参数或仅优化运行框架的基线，并取得最高成功率；平均成功率为百分之七十点三，在具身交互基准上达到百分之九十七。

Conclusion: 模型与运行框架需要协同优化，单独改进其中一方可能限制整体性能。联合训练能够缓解二者不兼容问题，并借助自身生成的任务轨迹持续改进。

Abstract: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

</details>


### [328] [Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11504)
*Chunwei Ma,Russell D Wolfinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MoE-Learner，利用数据嵌入的变异函数评估不同因果估计方法的假设是否与观测数据相容，并据此选择合适的估计专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果推断无法观测反事实结果，因此训练目标与实际推断目标之间存在差距。因果基础模型虽能借助大规模合成数据预训练简化估计流程，却可能掩盖模型针对特定数据所依赖的假设。由于真实数据的生成机制多样，研究者通常难以预先判断哪种因果估计策略适用；本文希望以可从数据中检验的方式评估这种适配性。

Method: 构建由多个因果专家组成的混合框架。每个专家对应一组特定假设，并从相应视角嵌入数据；随后利用嵌入的几何特征，尤其是变异函数，作为无需反事实结果的路由信号，评估各专家假设与数据的相容程度，并据此选择估计策略。该方法并非消除因果假设，而是将假设验证从事先固定选择转为基于数据几何的检查。

Result: 在 IHDP、ACIC 和 Lalonde 基准数据集上，MoE-Learner取得了最佳平均排名。摘要未提供具体数值或显著性检验结果。

Conclusion: 数据嵌入的几何特征可为因果估计策略的适用性提供有用线索。MoE-Learner将数据特征与因果方法选择连接起来，与因果基础模型相互补充，而非提出另一种基础模型。

Abstract: Due to the fundamental problem of causal inference -- the impossibility of observing counterfactual outcomes -- there is always a gap between the training goal (outcome, propensity) and the inference target (CATE, ATE). Traditional causal effect estimation revolves around setting assumptions, selecting identification strategies, and choosing causal estimators, while more recently, Causal Foundation Models (CFMs), built on Prior-Data-Fitted Networks (PFNs), ease this process by pretraining on massive synthetic prior datasets. Despite their success, such amortization makes causal inference less transparent, obscuring which assumptions the model implicitly relies on for a given dataset. The high diversity of real-world data-generating processes (DGPs) and Structural Causal Models (SCMs) makes it hard to know, a priori, which causal inference strategy is compatible with a given dataset. In this work, we focus on this compatibility between an observational dataset and method-specific assumptions, and find that geometric characteristics of data embeddings -- specifically, the variogram -- provide a useful signal of whether a given causal estimation strategy is appropriate. We develop MoE-Learner, a mixture-of-causal-experts framework that embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram as a counterfactual-free router to assess each expert's validity. Rather than eliminating causal assumptions, this shifts their validation from a fixed, a priori choice to a criterion that can be checked directly from data geometry. MoE-Learner achieves the best average rank on benchmark datasets (IHDP, ACIC, Lalonde). Being orthogonal to (causal) foundation models, our method builds a bridge from data characteristics to causal estimation strategy rather than proposing another CFM.

</details>


### [329] [ConvLUT: Rethinking Convolutional Architectures for Ultra-Low-Latency LUT-Based Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11507)
*Marta Andronic,Olivia Weng,Danial Zuberi,Ryan Kastner,George A. Constantinides*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出面向现场可编程门阵列的查找表卷积神经网络，通过树状查找表、分通道池化和硬件感知剪枝，支持图像与音频任务；在保持有竞争力准确率的同时，将完全展开推理延迟降至约五十纳秒以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于查找表的神经网络能够在现场可编程门阵列上实现极低延迟推理，但既有方法主要局限于多层感知机结构，难以处理具有空间或时序结构的视觉、音频任务。论文旨在拓展此类网络的架构能力，并解决卷积感受野维度过高带来的硬件映射困难。

Method: 提出一组完全展开、可映射到查找表的卷积架构，包括基于查找表树的标准卷积模型，以及遵循移动端网络设计思路的深度可分离卷积模型。方法包含统一的卷积框架，在显式扇入约束下支持标准卷积、深度卷积和逐点卷积；利用查找表树应对卷积感受野维度随卷积核大小和通道数增长的瓶颈；采用按通道分区的查找表池化替代传统空间池化；并使用硬件感知的迭代剪枝策略，提升大规模训练与收敛的稳定性。

Result: 在图像分类、视觉唤醒词识别和关键词识别任务上，模型取得了有竞争力的准确率，完全展开推理延迟低于约五十纳秒。在图像分类任务中，相比先前非逻辑电路实现的方案，延迟至少降低八千八百四十四倍；相比同任务上的既有多层感知机式查找表模型，测试准确率至少提升二十个百分点。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，借助适配硬件约束的卷积结构与查找表组织方式，查找表神经网络可从多层感知机拓展至结构化视觉和音频任务，并实现极低延迟推理。结果显示，这一路线有望兼顾准确率与硬件速度，适用于资源受限的边缘推理场景。

Abstract: Lookup-table (LUT)-based neural networks (NNs) offer a compelling path to ultra-low-latency inference on FPGAs. However, existing LUT-based neural networks have largely been restricted to MLP-style topologies, leaving structured vision and audio tasks underexplored. We present ConvLUT, a family of fully unrolled LUT-mappable convolutional architectures targeting the MLPerf Tiny benchmarks. It is comprised of a standard convolutional model built around a hierarchical tree of LUTs and a depthwise separable model following the MobileNet design philosophy. These architectures are enabled by four key contributions: a unified LUT-based convolutional framework supporting standard, depthwise, and pointwise convolutions under explicit fan-in constraints; a LUT-tree that addresses the $k^2c$ receptive field dimensionality bottleneck; a channel-partitioned LUT pooling layer that replaces conventional spatial pooling; and a hardware-aware iterative pruning strategy for stable convergence at scale. Evaluated on CIFAR-10, Visual Wake Words, and Keyword Spotting, ConvLUT achieves competitive accuracy with fully unrolled inference latencies below $\sim 50$ ns. On CIFAR-10 it reaches at least a $8844\times$ latency reduction over non-logic-based prior implementations, and outperforms existing MLP-style LUT-based models on the same task by at least $20$ pp in test accuracy.

</details>


### [330] [Detecting Common Golfing Faults Using AI and Video-Derived Biomechanical Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11515)
*Oliver Martin,Jeff Clark,Nawid Keshtmand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种无需标记点或摄像机标定、可从普通视频识别高尔夫挥杆错误的方法；在两类常见错误上取得较高识别效果，并能追溯判断依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动技术评估有助于提升表现与安全性，但实验室之外往往依赖教练目测。研究旨在让高尔夫挥杆错误能够通过普通手机视频进行客观、快速且可解释的评估。

Method: 流程先追踪人体姿态与杆头，并将动作表示在以身体为中心的坐标系中；再提取教练常用的生物力学量，例如杆头相对挥杆平面的高度，并在下杆的特定阶段使用浅层提升树分类。研究不采用端到端黑箱学习，分析对象为由外向内挥杆路径错误和过早伸展两类问题。

Result: 在公开来源的挥杆数据上，模型对由外向内挥杆路径错误和过早伸展的交叉验证受试者工作特征曲线下面积分别为0.975和0.911。模型最依赖的信号与教练诊断这些错误时关注的指标一致；在消费级笔记本电脑上处理手机视频只需数秒。

Conclusion: 该方法兼具较高识别性能、可解释性和较低使用门槛，有望发展为面向不同水平高尔夫球手的应用，并扩展到其他可依据生物力学参照评估动作技术的运动项目。

Abstract: Understanding how an athlete moves can improve both technique and safety, yet outside the laboratory technique is still assessed by eye. We present a pipeline that detects named golf swing faults from ordinary video, without markers or calibration. Instead of learning end to end, it tracks body pose and the clubhead in a body-centered frame, and classifies the biomechanical quantities a coach would measure, such as the height of the clubhead above the swing plane, with shallow boosted trees. We demonstrate the approach on two common faults, coming over-the-top (OTT) and early-extension (EE). On 160 swings and 143 swings from public sources it detects OTT and EE with a cross-validated ROC-AUC of 0.975 and 0.911 respectively. Because every feature is a biomechanical quantity a coach already uses, measured at a known phase of the downswing, each decision can be traced to the signals and the moments of the swing that drove it. The signals the model relies on most are the same ones a coach checks when diagnosing these faults. The pipeline processes phone video on a consumer laptop in seconds, so it could feasibly be developed into an app for golfers of all abilities and extended to other sports in which technique is judged against a biomechanical reference.

</details>


### [331] [Hydra: Towards Transferable Multi-Task Learning on Temporal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11520)
*Kiarash Shamsi,Farimah Poursafaei,Tran Gia Bao Ngo,Reihaneh Rabbany,Baris Coskunuzer,Guillaume Rabusseau,Michael M. Bronstein,Shenyang Huang,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出海德拉模型，结合时序图的局部连接特征与全局谱特征，面向多任务图属性预测；实验显示其预测表现优于或媲美强基线，且训练更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实网络随时间演化，预测其未来属性有助于下游决策。现有时序图方法主要针对单一任务设计，其跨任务泛化及向未见网络迁移的能力研究不足，因此时序图上的多任务属性预测仍是开放问题。

Method: 海德拉将时序图神经网络提取的局部连接信息，与用于捕获全局连接模式的谱学习模块结合，并通过多任务目标联合学习局部和全局特征，以支持多任务分类与回归。

Result: 在多任务分类中，海德拉的曲线下面积指标较最强竞争方法相对提升百分之八点九。在多任务回归的三项任务中，海德拉均取得有竞争力的结果，并在其中两项达到最佳，平均绝对误差较最强基线相对降低百分之八点二。此外，相较时序迁移模型，训练时间减少百分之二十二。

Conclusion: 研究首次系统表明，在时序图上进行可迁移的多任务学习是有效的。海德拉稳定的领先表现说明，多任务训练有望推动适用于多种任务与网络的时序图基础模型发展。

Abstract: Real-world evolving networks are naturally modeled as temporal graphs (TGs), where capturing temporal dynamics is essential for predicting future graph properties that support downstream decision-making. Existing temporal graph methods have been developed primarily for single-task prediction, and little is known about their generalization across tasks or transfer to unseen networks. This leaves the challenge of multi-task graph property prediction in TGs largely open. We address this challenge by introducing Hydra, a novel architecture that integrates local connectivity features from temporal GNNs with a spectral learning module that captures global connectivity patterns. This design enables joint learning of local and global information under a multi-task objective. In multi-task classification, Hydra achieves an 8.9% relative gain in AUC over the strongest competitor. In multi-task regression, Hydra achieves competitive results in all three tasks, while obtaining the best results in two tasks with a 8.2% relative gain in MAE compared to the strongest baseline. Moreover, Hydra delivers these gains with a 22% reduction in training time compared to temporal transfer models. These results provide the first systematic evidence that multi-task transferable learning on temporal graphs is effective. By delivering consistent top-ranked performance, Hydra highlights multi-task training on temporal graphs as a promising direction toward adaptable foundation models for temporal graphs.

</details>


### [332] [Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11525)
*Siming Zhang,Zhehui Shen,Shijie Chen,Yansen Yu,Hang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“有效边界复杂度”，通过测量决策边界附近的目标样本比例，估计冻结表征还需要多少标注才能学好下游分类边界；实验表明，该指标能补充现有表征迁移诊断，并与实际标注需求相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低标注迁移的关键实际问题是：表征看起来有用之后，还需要多少标签才能确定下游分类边界？现有可迁移性和探针质量指标主要描述整体对齐、似然、间隔或校准，难以直接反映边界附近的模糊样本，而这些样本往往最需要标注。因此，论文旨在提供一种针对边界难度的补充诊断。

Method: 提出有效边界复杂度，用窄带内的样本质量衡量决策边界附近的歧义程度，并按类别比例归一化，从而同时计入模糊区域的密度和预测类别失衡。论文证明，在表征映射平滑时，密度变化与边界切向表面变化的一阶效应相互抵消，边界法向的拉伸或压缩决定主要变化规律。实际估计时，先在一个数据划分上训练线性探针，再用独立留出特征统计其边界附近的样本；另以可微代理目标降低该复杂度。

Result: 在七十四种受控变换中，测得结果与理论规律吻合，中位相对误差为百分之零点三八。真实冻结特征实验显示，法向变化会同时改变边界质量和标注需求，而切向控制符合一阶不变性预测。可微代理目标在保持相同最高分类准确率的情况下，将测得复杂度降低百分之十六至三十六。在图像分类数据集及五分类实验中，该指标支持对近似持平的表征作进一步比较；一对多分类界面的骨干网络排序一致性为零点八七二。跨三种样本采集策略，初始边界质量与实际标注预算的相关系数为零点七七九至零点八三零。

Conclusion: 有效边界复杂度可作为现有迁移诊断的第二阶段指标，尤其适用于整体表征质量相近时，评估边界附近的标注难度并辅助估计标签预算。其理论分析解释了表征变换如何影响该指标，实验则显示它与实际标注需求及模型排序具有较强关联。

Abstract: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.

</details>


### [333] [A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11526)
*Baiyu Su,Lizhang Chen,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文以动力系统视角分析解耦权重衰减自适应矩估计优化器，揭示其固定点对应特定约束正则化问题的驻点，但固定点未必稳定；并提出保持固定点不变的收敛改进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该优化器在深度学习中广泛使用，但其对应的优化目标及收敛行为尚未充分厘清。尤其是，算法的固定点是否稳定，以及曲率、权重衰减和动量参数如何影响稳定性，仍需系统分析。

Method: 将优化器的迭代过程置于动力系统框架中，刻画其隐式固定点目标，并分析固定点与约束正则化优化问题驻点之间的关系。研究者进一步考察一维情形下的稳定性与振荡现象，并推广至高维连续时间动力学，推导局部稳定的充分条件；同时提出一种保留原固定点的收敛改进方案。

Result: 分析表明，固定点并不必然稳定，其稳定性会敏感地受到目标曲率、权重衰减及动量参数影响。即使在一维情形中，也可能出现不稳定平衡点，且迭代轨迹可能持续振荡而非收敛。对于高维连续时间系统，论文给出了局部稳定的充分条件。

Conclusion: 该研究明确了这一优化器隐含关联的优化问题，并指出仅识别固定点不足以保证算法收敛，还必须考察动力学稳定性。所得条件与改进方案有助于判断何时可以期待收敛，并为设计更可靠的优化器提供思路。

Abstract: AdamW is ubiquitous in deep learning, yet its behavior remains poorly understood. We analyze its dynamics through the lens of dynamical systems and show that AdamW admits an implicit fixed-point objective: its fixed points coincide with the stationary points of a constrained and regularized optimization problem. However, not all of these fixed points are stable under AdamW's dynamics, and stability depends sensitively on curvature, weight decay, and momentum parameters. Even in one-dimensional settings, equilibria may be unstable, and trajectories can exhibit persistent oscillations rather than convergence to them. We further extend the analysis to higher dimensions, deriving sufficient conditions for local stability of the continuous-time dynamics, and propose a convergent modification that preserves AdamW's fixed points. These results clarify what optimization problem AdamW is associated with, when its convergence can be expected, and how its dynamics could inspire more reliable optimizers.

</details>


### [334] [Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11531)
*Ambroise Odonnat,Theo Gnassounou,Laetitia Chapel,Romain Tavenard,Ievgen Redko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，探测变换器表示时应同时选择网络层与模块，而不能只关注网络深度；简单固定策略也能有效提升下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常将每个变换器模块视为整体，并主要沿网络深度分析表示，通常探测中间层或最终层的整体表示。然而，这种做法可能忽略同一层内不同模块所包含的有用特征，也无法揭示模块表现如何随层数变化。

Method: 作者对视觉基础模型和大型语言模型开展超过十四万四千次线性探测评估，逐层、逐模块比较表示效果，并联合考察层与模块的选择。随后评估两种无需逐模型搜索的固定策略：视觉模型采用最终层的前馈网络激活，语言模型采用网络深度约百分之六十处的第二个归一化层。

Result: 联合选择层与模块所取得的最佳效果，显著优于固定使用残差流时仅选择最佳层。模块表现会因所在层而大幅变化。在多数评估中，两种固定策略均优于基线；它们平均分别取得视觉模型最佳层—模块组合增益的百分之四十二，以及语言模型增益的百分之八十六。对于视觉模型，增益会随预训练数据与下游数据之间的迁移难度增加而提高。

Conclusion: 变换器表示的有效性不能仅用网络深度刻画，模块类型与层位置必须联合考虑。尽管逐模型寻找最佳组合能获得更高效果，简单且固定的探测位置也能回收相当部分收益，尤其适用于语言模型。

Abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

</details>


### [335] [Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11529)
*Soyon Choi,Scott Alfeld,Meiyi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文关注由多个机器学习模型组成的系统安全，提出针对状态机式人工智能系统的攻击策略计算框架，旨在推动组合式学习安全研究与合作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究广泛揭示单个机器学习算法可能遭受操纵或欺骗，但现实中的网络物理系统常将视觉、规划等模型组合起来，影响系统状态并驱动物理行动。如何将针对单个模型的攻击能力用于攻击整个组合系统，仍不清楚。

Method: 作者提出面向数据操纵型攻击者的分析框架，将攻击策略定义为从系统状态映射到攻击行为的规则；同时描述基础威胁模型及计算最优攻击策略的方法，并讨论后续扩展方向。

Result: 本文属于进行中的研究论文，主要贡献是提出框架、基础威胁模型和最优攻击策略计算方法的思路。摘要未报告实验设计、定量结果或实际系统评估。

Conclusion: 评估机器学习系统安全时，不能只考察孤立模型，还需研究模型组合及其对系统状态和物理行为的整体影响。本文旨在为这一研究方向建立基础，并促进学术交流与合作。

Abstract: There is a well-established body of work demonstrating that individual machine learning (ML) algorithms can be manipulated or deceived. However, in many real-world systems, multiple ML algorithms are composed to enable automated decision-making, particularly in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Often such systems use a composition of vision, planning, and other ML models to affect their internal state and ultimate take actions in the physical world. While there is a huge literature on the (in)security of ML algorithms, it is not immediately clear how an attacker might leverage their ability to trick individual learners when attacking the composition as a whole. We develop methods for creating an attack policy (a mapping from state to attack) for a data-manipulating attacker affecting a CPS or other state-machine-based AI compositions. We describe our framework, a basic threat model and corresponding methods for computing an optimal attack policy, as well as planned extensions. The goal of this work-in-progress paper is to stimulate conversation and forge new collaborations regarding the security of compositional learning.

</details>


### [336] [Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11696)
*Rafael Pina,Varuna De Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文直接测量两类神经网络工作负载的图形处理器能耗，发现跨批次共享计算对循环策略网络尚无可靠节能效果，但对混合专家语言模型有效；在后者中，按批次调整路由可减少专家权重读取并降低单词元能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络能效常由运算量间接推断，但运算量减少不一定带来实际能耗下降。论文因此直接测量图形处理器能耗，检验不同工作负载能否让批次中的样本跨样本、跨时间共享计算，并确认这种共享是否确实节能。

Method: 研究两类批处理特性差异显著的任务：图形处理器向量化多智能体强化学习中的循环策略，以及混合专家语言模型。作者进行直接能耗测量，并考察共享活动模式、冻结掩码、训练所得掩码及测试时引导等策略。对于语言模型，测试批次感知路由，并提出具有单一参数、考虑路由持续性的专家激活规则；同时评估专家权重读取量、输出分布差异、基准测试表现及每词元能耗。

Result: 循环策略网络中，虽然存在共享活动模式，但通常无法持续超过一个时间步；冻结策略掩码无效。训练所得掩码只有在等价于较窄的门控循环单元时才有效，而作者实现中的能耗仍是小型稠密策略的十一倍。测试时引导在两类任务上都没有带来重新选择方案之外的收益。混合专家模型方面，在通义千问三代三百亿总参数、三十亿激活参数模型上，批次感知路由在输出分布的相对熵差异不超过零点零五时，可少读取百分之二十五至三十一的专家权重；五百个样本的基准变化处于噪声范围内，融合前向计算的每词元能耗降低百分之十二至十八。持续性感知规则在批次大小为三十二至六十四时，保持批次感知裁剪效果，同时比原生路由少约百分之四十的新专家，但其能耗尚未测量。

Conclusion: 跨批次共享计算是否节能取决于工作负载与粒度：循环策略网络的共享模式难以持续，现有方案未证明能耗优势；混合专家模型则可通过批次感知路由减少权重读取并实测降低能耗。持续性感知规则显示出减少专家切换的潜力，但节能效果仍待验证。研究属于单一图形处理器类型上的试点测量，结论的适用范围有限。

Abstract: Energy claims for efficient neural networks are often inferred from operation counts. We report direct GPU energy measurements on two workloads that batch very differently, recurrent policies in GPU-vectorised multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, and ask one question of both: can the rows of a batch be made to share computation, across the batch and over time, at a measured saving? On recurrent policies the answer so far is no. Shared activity patterns exist but rarely last one step, masking a frozen policy fails, and trained-in masks succeed only because a fixed mask is equivalent to a narrow GRU, at 11x the energy of a small dense policy in our implementation. Test-time steering adds nothing beyond re-picking on either workload. On MoE models the answer is yes, and granularity decides how much: on Qwen3-30B-A3B, batch-aware routing reads 25-31% fewer expert weights within KL 0.05, with benchmark changes within noise at 500 items, and uses 12-18% less energy per token on a fused forward. We also introduce persistence-aware OEA, a one-parameter rule that keeps the batch-aware cut with about 40% fewer new experts per step than native routing at batch 32-64, though its energy has not yet been measured. These are pilot measurements on one GPU type, and we state their limits.

</details>


### [337] [UTOPI: Efficient Egocentric Long-Video Understanding in AR via User-Guided Token Pre-Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11562)
*Ziqi Wang,Su Chen,Qiance Tang,Jieyu Lin,Ziyun Li,Barbara De Salvo,Sai Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出面向增强现实设备的第一视角长视频预压缩模块，通过运动信号和眼动注视信息减少冗余内容，最高压缩率可达百分之九十五，同时保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一视角长视频存在大量时间冗余，而增强现实设备的内存与计算资源有限，直接处理视频会带来显著负担。因此，论文旨在压缩视频、降低资源消耗，同时尽可能保留对理解任务有用的信息。

Method: 提出可插拔的预压缩模块。首先利用用户运动信号估计相邻帧之间的重叠程度，并设计对视点变化具有不变性的帧剪枝算法。其次利用眼动传感器定位用户注视区域，区分受关注的前景与背景，并通过经微调的神经网络调整机制优先保留受关注内容。

Result: 在多个基准数据集和不同模型骨干网络上的实验显示，该方法最高可将视频压缩百分之九十五，同时保持模型性能。摘要未提供具体任务指标或不同设置下的详细数值。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，结合用户运动与注视信息，可以有针对性地压缩增强现实场景中的第一视角长视频，在降低存储和计算负担的同时保留任务所需内容。该模块具有即插即用特性，适用于资源受限的增强现实平台。

Abstract: As long-video understanding gains increasing attention, augmented reality (AR) devices are emerging as a compelling deployment platform. However, egocentric videos exhibit significant temporal redundancy, imposing substantial memory and computational burdens on resource-constrained AR hardware. To address this challenge, we introduce UTOPI, a plug-and-play pre-compression module designed specifically for egocentric long videos on AR platforms. First, we leverage user motion signals to estimate inter-frame overlap and propose a viewpoint-shift-invariant pruning algorithm. Second, we exploit eye-tracking sensors to identify user fixations, enabling the separation of attended foreground content from background and its preferential retention via a fine-tuned neural network-based adjustment mechanism. Across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, UTOPI achieves up to 95% compression while preserving performance. Code and project page are available at https://sai-lab-nyu.github.io/utopi/.

</details>


### [338] [Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11704)
*Peiyu Li,Pouya Hosseinzadeh,Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi,Shah Muhammad Hamdi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于策略学习的时间序列反事实解释方法，在推理时通过一次前向计算直接生成反事实样本，避免针对每个输入进行迭代优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列存在复杂的时间依赖关系，使反事实样本难以生成；传统方法通常需要针对每个输入单独迭代优化，计算开销较大，也不利于扩展。本文旨在学习可迁移的生成策略，以兼顾生成效率、有效性与合理性。

Method: 方法将反事实生成建模为一步式上下文赌博机策略学习问题。在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中训练演员—评论家智能体，使其学习数据的全局结构规律。训练完成后，策略可对新输入直接执行一次前向计算，生成反事实样本，无需再进行逐样本优化。

Result: 在13个时间序列基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多种异常检测指标下取得了较高的反事实有效性和较强的合理性。摘要未提供具体数值，因此无法进一步比较提升幅度。

Conclusion: 通过将反事实生成与逐样本优化解耦，该框架为时间序列反事实解释提供了一种高效且可扩展的方案。其核心优势是利用预先学得的策略实现快速生成，同时保持生成结果的有效性与合理性。

Abstract: Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.

</details>


### [339] [Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11565)
*Bian Sun,Kevin Zhai,Mubarak Shah,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该方法利用历史经验调整动作选择，并在最后阶段有条件地重放有效动作序列；在三类交互环境的三十三种任务与预算设置中，终局得分指标有三十一种达到最佳或并列最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体可通过反复尝试积累反馈来改进决策，无须更新模型参数，但现有做法存在两项局限：反复取得相同分数的动作可能持续获得正向强化，阻碍智能体追求更高分数；而在交互预算所剩不多时探索新动作，也可能降低最终表现。

Method: 该方法根据历史得分调整动作信用：降低那些在先前回合中反复达到相同分数的动作信用，并提高带来更高分数的动作片段的信用，以此调节模型提出的动作概率。在最后几个回合中，若当前情境与记录情境相符且相关动作仍可执行，则直接重放已存储的动作序列，跳过模型生成候选动作的环节。

Result: 实验覆盖杰里科、科学世界和工匠三类环境，并以交互预算结束时最后四个回合的平均得分作为指标。在三十三种任务与预算设置中，该方法有三十一种取得最佳或并列最佳成绩。在杰里科各预算设置下，最后四个回合中有百分之七十八点九至百分之八十六点三的候选动作生成调用被重放机制跳过（按游戏平均）。

Conclusion: 结合得分导向的动作信用调整与情境匹配的动作重放，有助于智能体在有限交互预算内继续提升表现，同时保留已取得的成绩。实验结果显示，该策略在多类环境及预算设置下具有较强的终局表现；不过摘要未提供各基线的具体分数或显著性检验信息。

Abstract: LLM agents can use feedback from repeated attempts to improve their decisions without updating model parameters. However, positive action credits can continue to favor actions that repeatedly achieve the same score, even when higher scores are achievable. Under a fixed interaction budget, trying new actions in the final attempts can also lower performance. We introduce EARN, a method that uses past experience to guide further progress and retain earlier performance through conditional reuse of effective action sequences. EARN reduces action credits for reaching scores repeatedly attained in earlier episodes and assigns larger credits to action segments that reach higher scores. These credits adjust the probabilities of LLM-proposed actions. During the final episodes, EARN directly replays stored actions when the current context matches the recorded context and the actions remain available, bypassing LLM candidate generation. We evaluate performance at the end of the interaction budget using the average score over the final four episodes. Across Jericho, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, EARN achieves the best score on this metric in 31 of 33 task--budget settings among the evaluated methods, including ties. Across the evaluated Jericho budgets, replay bypasses 78.9--86.3\% of candidate-generation calls in the final four episodes, averaged across games.

</details>


### [340] [Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11752)
*Khurram Khalil,Khaza Anuarul Hoque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，更新的低稳定秩与其需要大量奇异分量才能覆盖主要能量并不矛盾；训练位移的方向则会随训练阶段和优势估计方法而变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究对语言模型后训练更新的谱性质得出看似冲突的结论：更新可能接近满秩，但变化又表现为低稳定秩。本文旨在解释这种差异，并进一步刻画训练过程中连续检查点位移的方向关系，以及优势估计方法是否会影响这种方向对齐。

Method: 首先，对奇异值按幂律衰减的情形进行理论分析，证明当指数处于给定范围时，稳定秩相对于固定能量秩会随维度增长而变得可忽略。其次，对选定的策略优化注意力更新进行完整奇异值分解，并计算多个可验证奖励强化学习阶段中相邻检查点的全模型位移余弦。最后，在受控实验中使用三个配对随机种子和相同训练设置，比较组相对优势与基于学习型评论家的广义优势估计。

Result: 理论与分解结果显示，稳定秩虽仅为九点六至十八点三，但要覆盖百分之八十的更新能量仍需五百三十二至一千二百二十二个奇异分量。九个强化学习阶段的全部一百三十一对相邻检查点，在各自原生检查点间隔上均呈负余弦。监督微调中的方向对齐则依配置而异，部分模型在训练后期也出现负余弦。受控实验中，后期组相对优势的平均余弦为正零点二五九，评论家方法为正零点零一二；两者配对差值为负零点二四七，百分之九十五区间为负零点三五八至负零点一三七。

Conclusion: 低稳定秩不意味着更新能量集中于极少数奇异方向；稳定秩、能量覆盖所需秩和轨迹方向是不同性质，应分别衡量。训练位移的方向并非普遍一致，且在匹配训练条件下，优势估计系统会影响方向对齐。

Abstract: Language-model post-training modifies weights through cumulative updates and successive displacements, yet existing studies report seemingly conflicting spectral properties: nearly full-rank updates and low stable-rank changes. We show these observations are compatible and characterize update directions during training. For singular values following $σ_i \propto i^{-α}$ with $0 < α\leq 1/2$, we prove that stable rank becomes negligible relative to fixed-energy rank as dimension increases. Full singular value decompositions of selected OLMo-2-7B updates confirm this separation: three proximal policy optimization (PPO) attention updates have stable ranks of 9.6-18.3 but require 532-1,222 singular components to capture 80% of their energy. We next compute consecutive checkpoint-displacement cosines from full-model inner products. Across nine publicly released reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) stages, all 131 adjacent pairs have negative cosines on their native checkpoint grids, including PPO and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning comparisons across four model families show configuration-dependent alignment, including negative late-training cosines for Mistral and FP32 Llama. Finally, a controlled OLMo-2-1B study with three paired seeds and a 2,048-token response cap compares group-relative advantages against a learned critic with generalized advantage estimation (GAE). At matched 60-rollout windows, late-training mean cosines are +0.259 and +0.012, respectively; the paired critic-minus-group difference is -0.247 (seed-level 95% interval [-0.358, -0.137]). These findings distinguish spectral concentration, energy coverage, and trajectory direction, and demonstrate that the advantage system influences directional alignment under matched training conditions.

</details>


### [341] [Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11609)
*Sergei V. Kalinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出预算受限的自主显微实验框架，使显微镜能够联合决定测量位置、采集信息类型、扫描速度及再校准时机，并用真实电子能量损失谱数据验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主显微镜若只优化测量位置，仍难以有效推动科学发现；实验还需在有限预算下权衡成像与光谱采集、扫描速率、仪器漂移和再校准。因此，研究需要一种可复现、可比较且能独立审计的多步骤结构—性质实验设计方法。

Method: 构建预算受限的决策框架，综合显式科学收益、动作成本、仪器观测模型、实验前知识向在线实验的迁移，以及独立于控制器的效果评估。迁移知识包括预测器的准确度与计算成本、用于加权模型收益的经验学习成熟度函数，以及控制器训练前测定的漂移特征。研究开展两类实验：一类选择成像或光谱、图像尺寸和扫描速度；另一类在此基础上加入漂移条件下的再校准决策。

Result: 基于真实电子能量损失谱数据的实验表明，响应发现与结构—性质学习适合不同的代理模型和采集策略；简单采集规则也能成为有竞争力的实用基线。独立误差分析揭示，模型不确定性并非始终能可靠代表学习价值。漂移实验中，显式图像配准显著提升了位置精度，同时框架量化了其对光谱采集吞吐量的代价。

Conclusion: 该框架为自主实验的设计、比较与审计提供了可复现的方法，并指出显微镜部署此类系统所需的基础能力：可独立执行的动作、经过表征的扫描与探测器响应、带时间戳的配准遥测数据，以及完整的动作记录。

Abstract: Autonomous microscopy can turn fast acquisition into scientific progress when it decides not only where to measure, but also what information to acquire, at what scan rate, and when to recalibrate the instrument. We develop a budget constrained framework for such multistep structure-property workflows. It combines explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models, transfer of pre experiment knowledge into the online campaign, and evaluation kept independent of the controller. The transferred knowledge includes predictor accuracy and computational cost, empirical learner maturity functions that weight model-derived rewards, and drift characteristics established before controller training. Using a real electron energy-loss spectroscopy dataset, we run two complementary campaigns. In the first, the controller chooses between imaging and spectroscopy, image size, and scan speed. In the second, the instrument drifts and the controller also decides when to recalibrate. The campaigns show that response discovery and structure-property learning favor different surrogate models and acquisition strategies. They also show that simple acquisition rules form strong, practical baselines. Independent error analysis reveals where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal. In the drift campaign, explicit registration greatly improves positional accuracy, and the framework measures what this costs in spectroscopy throughput. Together, these results provide a reproducible way to design, compare, and audit autonomous experiments, and they define what microscopes must provide for deployment: independently executable actions, characterized scan and detector responses, timestamped registration telemetry, and complete action records.

</details>


### [342] [Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11910)
*Sina Barazandeh,Benjamin E. Lundell,Jose Lugo-Martinez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，在有硬性截止时间的自动化实验室中，语言模型回答质量与延迟必须联合评估；单独衡量两者会高估推理模式的实际价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室任务持续运行且按严格时限执行。若模型回答迟到，系统会执行安全兜底操作，例如拒收样本。因此，迟到答案即使本身质量较高，也可能无法改变实际行动；只报告答案质量和响应延迟，可能夸大推理带来的收益。

Method: 研究者在答案最优选项已知、运行时强制执行截止时间的合成样本决策任务中，比较同一模型的快速模式与先推理再回答的思考模式。通过预先设定的回放测试评估一千二百个新决策，并在三百个新决策上重复验证；此外，在单张图形处理器上同时发送请求，测试请求数量增加时思考模式的截止时间达成率。

Result: 在一千二百个决策中，思考模式的超时答案价值约为准时答案的五倍。以准时率乘以平均答案价值来预测实际价值，会高估思考模式的收益；相较快速模式，每个决策高估零点零二四一，重复实验中高估零点零一九一，两项结果的百分之九十五置信区间均未包含零。负载实验中，请求数从八个增至五十六个时，思考模式在四十五秒内完成的比例从百分之七十九点二降至百分之一点四，尽管总输出量增至三倍。

Conclusion: 评估实验室智能体时，应将每个答案的价值与到达时间结合起来，并依据截止时间后系统实际执行的行动计分，而不能仅用答案质量与准时率的简单组合估算效用。研究结果也显示，并发负载会显著削弱较慢推理模式在时限约束下的实际价值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly plan and run experiments in automated laboratories. These experiments keep running while the model reasons and run on schedules with hard deadlines. If an LLM-generated answer arrives late, the system executes a safe fallback action instead, such as rejecting a sample. This creates a systems problem that standard serving metrics do not capture. An answer that matches the fallback adds no value, and answers that differ from the fallback may require more reasoning time. Reporting answer quality and latency separately can therefore overstate the value of reasoning. We test this on synthetic sample decisions, where the best choice is known exactly and a runtime enforces the deadline. We compare one LLM's fast mode, which answers directly, with its thinking mode, which reasons first. In a prespecified replay of 1,200 new decisions, thinking answers that missed a deadline were worth about five times as much as on-time ones. Multiplying the on-time rate by the mean answer value predicted about twice the value that thinking delivered. This prediction overstated thinking's advantage over fast mode by 0.0241 per decision, and by 0.0191 in a repeat on 300 new decisions. Both 95% confidence intervals excluded zero. In a single-GPU Qwen3-8B experiment using simultaneous request bursts, raising the number of requests from 8 to 56 reduced the share of thinking answers that met a 45 s deadline from 79.2% to 1.4%, although total output tripled. Evaluations of LLM agents for laboratories should therefore measure each answer's value and arrival time together and score the action that actually runs.

</details>


### [343] [Daily Emergency Call Volume Forecasting using Univariate and Multivariate TimeGPT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11613)
*Feriel Fass,Djemel Ziou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，预训练时间序列基础模型并未提升急救电话量预测效果；传统统计模型在该任务中表现更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估时间序列预训练基础模型能否有效预测真实场景中的每日急救电话量，并检验其在单变量、多变量及不同预测步长下，相较于传统统计与机器学习方法的优势。

Method: 使用包含二千一百零一天观测值的急救电话数据，开展单变量和多变量预测，并分别评估提前一天与提前七天的预测。多变量模型纳入时间、气象、人口统计和社会经济变量。研究按时间顺序划分训练集、验证集和测试集，以避免信息泄漏；通过验证集网格搜索选择超参数，并在适用时采用提前停止。使用多种误差指标，将时间序列预训练模型与季节性自回归综合滑动平均外生变量模型、泊松回归、负二项回归、极端梯度提升、多层感知机和长短期记忆网络进行比较。

Result: 单变量预测中，季节性自回归综合滑动平均外生变量模型总体表现最佳；多变量预测中，负二项回归和泊松回归表现最佳。时间序列预训练模型没有展现出稳定的预测优势。

Conclusion: 大规模预训练并不必然转化为特定应用中的更高预测精度。对于急救电话量预测，仅利用现有数据训练的简约方法可能更有效；模型选择应依据具体任务和实证表现，而非仅凭模型规模或预训练优势。

Abstract: This study investigates the potential of TimeGPT, a pretrained foundation model for timeseries, for forecasting daily emergency call volumes. Real-world emergency call data, comprising 2,101 daily observations, are used to evaluate both univariate and multivariate forecasting settings under one-step-ahead and seven-day multi-step-ahead scenarios. The multivariate forecasting incorporates temporal, meteorological, demographic, and socioeconomic variables. A chronological training, validation, and test split is adopted to prevent information leakage, while hyperparameters are selected using the validation set through grid search and early stopping when applicable. Forecasting performance is evaluated using multiple error metrics. Its forecasting performance is compared with several established forecasting approaches, including Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Poisson regression (PR), Negative Binomial regression (NBR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The results show that SARIMAX achieves the best overall performance in the univariate setting. In the multivariate setting, NBR and PR provide best performance. These findings indicate that the large-scale pretraining of TimeGPT do not necessarily translate into superior forecasting accuracy for emergency call volumes. Frugal methods trained solely on the available data remain better for this application.

</details>


### [344] [An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11921)
*Xian Yeow Lee,Ryoichi Takase,Ahmed Farahat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，预训练表格基础模型无需针对任务训练，数据有限且上下文充足时可较准确地预测系统状态；但推理较慢，整体仍不能替代经过充分训练的世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型有望支持基于模型的强化学习与机器人规划，但通常需要针对具体任务使用大量交互数据训练。本文探讨预训练表格基础模型能否在不进行任务训练的情况下，通过利用已有状态转移样本作为上下文，完成下一状态预测，并分析其适用范围与局限。

Method: 将下一状态预测表述为基于上下文的回归问题，以状态转移样本作为模型输入。在合成动力学系统和机器人运动基准上，将该模型与从头训练的长短期记忆网络、多层感知机，以及在相同数据上拟合的其他回归器进行比较；同时评估多步自回归预测、上下文长度对效果的影响，以及推理速度。

Result: 在几乎所有数据有限的实验设置中，该模型都比使用相同少量转移数据从头训练的长短期记忆网络和多层感知机更准确；在机器人运动任务中，它也优于使用相同数据拟合的其他回归器，而高斯过程在平滑、低维系统上更准确。不过，在大多数系统中，使用完整数据训练的模型仍明显更好。多步预测对上下文长度十分敏感：上下文较短时，预测很快退化至简单基线水平；上下文较长时，效果显著改善，并在一个机器人运动任务中超过训练所得的长短期记忆网络。其推理速度则比后者慢约三个数量级。

Conclusion: 当前的免训练先验模型适合在数据稀缺且可提供充足上下文时充当预测器，但其效果受上下文长度制约，推理成本也较高，尚不足以取代经过训练的世界模型用于规划。

Abstract: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.

</details>


### [345] [GenISys: Integrated Ship Systems Design Using Subsystem-Conditional Tabular Diffussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11622)
*Noah J. Bagazinski,Faez Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种同步生成船舶各子系统的方法。在散货船设计实验中，该方法生成同时满足工程约束和低成本目标的方案比例高于整体式与顺序式生成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 船舶早期设计需要协调船体、结构、推进和运营等相互耦合的子系统，同时满足工程约束并权衡性能与成本。单独生成部件或将子系统割裂处理，难以体现它们之间的相互影响，因此需要能够联合生成并协调整个系统的方法。

Method: 研究提出集成系统生成框架，并以散货船早期设计为案例。数据集包含二十一万七千九百九十九个候选设计，其中一万六千二百四十七个满足所设工程约束。核心方法是同步条件去噪扩散概率模型，使多个子系统在生成过程中共同响应彼此变化。实验将其与整体式整船生成和顺序式子系统生成进行比较；每种架构均开展五次独立训练。评估任务要求航程为五千海里，并以降低单位货物运输成本为目标。

Result: 在生成请求中，同步条件扩散模型有百分之五十五点七的方案满足工程约束并达到共同的低成本目标；整体式模型为百分之五十一点一，顺序式模型为百分之四十七点五四。相较两者，合格方案比例分别提高百分之九和百分之十七点二，且估算运输成本相近。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在生成过程中同步协调相互耦合的子系统，有助于提高可行且符合性能与成本目标的整船设计方案比例。该研究展示了生成式人工智能用于集成系统设计的潜力；结论目前主要基于特定散货船案例、所设工程约束和成本目标。

Abstract: Ship design requires coordinating coupled subsystems to satisfy engineering constraints and balance competing performance and cost objectives. Generative artificial intelligence has supported component design, but integrated ship generation must also account for interactions among hull geometry, structure, propulsion, and operation. This paper presents GenISys, a framework for generating integrated systems, demonstrated through early-stage bulk-carrier design. Its dataset contains 217,999 proposed designs, including 16,247 that satisfy the formulated engineering constraints. The proposed simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) generates subsystems together, allowing each subsystem model to respond to changes elsewhere during generation. Experiments compare this approach with monolithic whole-ship generation and sequential subsystem generation across five independent training runs per architecture. In a study targeting lower cost per tonne of cargo transported, designs were generated for a required voyage range of 5,000 nautical miles. SCDDPM produced designs satisfying the formulated engineering constraints and meeting a common low-cost target in 55.70% of generation requests, compared with 51.10% for the monolithic model and 47.54% for the sequential model. These correspond to 9.0% and 17.2% more qualifying designs, respectively, while maintaining similar estimated transport costs. These results show how generative artificial intelligence can coordinate subsystems to generate feasible, high-performing integrated systems.

</details>


### [346] [Attention Is Only as Good as Its Witnesses: When Higher-Order Layers Help, and When They Do Not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11937)
*Mostafa 'Neo' Mohsenvand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文用逻辑深度与温度下读取见证的复杂度，解释注意力模型在图搜索和组合任务中的成败，并据此设计出更高效、泛化更强的网络结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准变换器在图规模增大时难以持续学习图搜索；学习集合卡牌游戏也需要大量不同题目。尽管注意力机制在表达能力上足以表示这些任务，实际表现却不稳定。论文希望从网络层如何汇总候选见证的角度，解释其深度、规模与学习能力之间的关系，并据此改进模型。

Method: 论文将所研究的网络层视为：以一定温度读取一族见证的配分函数，并提出两条规律。第一是深度规律：在两步游走上叠加的 L 层，恰能覆盖 2^L−1 步；作者给出达到该范围的构造，并用形式化证明工具验证，同时说明顶点没有名称时网络无法覆盖更远范围。第二是规模规律：要在最坏情况下、对任意候选规模正确判断是否存在见证，逆温度与分类间隔的乘积至少须达到候选数量对数。作者据此构建由析取合并通道和幂平均通道组成的模型，并测试相关设计原则；另以模 3 运算的牛顿方法，精确计算成对二单纯形注意力的软最大值。

Result: 一个传播层只用 49 个顶点的图训练，便能在 250 个顶点的图上回答所有搜索深度的问题。集合卡牌游戏实验中，六个时钟的模型所需题目数量与二单纯形注意力相当，并能从 8 张牌的桌面迁移到 20 张牌。算法推理基准的三十节点任务中，在不提供提示的条件下，含 18.6 万参数的模型在官方测试集 12 项任务中的 9 项达到与至少 7300 万参数模型相差不超过半分的水平或优于它；在重新抽取的测试图上，12 项中有 8 项达到这一标准。精确计算方法的运算量为 3^d n，其中 d 为时钟数、n 为规模参数。

Conclusion: 论文提出的逻辑深度界刻画了网络能传播多远，温度与候选规模的规律则刻画了判断存在性所需的容量条件。依据这些规律设计的网络，在图搜索、卡牌组合推理及多项图算法任务上表现出较强的泛化能力，并显著减少参数规模。该框架也能解释成对层未带来收益的情形，以及某些并行层为何仍需循环计算。

Abstract: Transformers stop learning graph search as graphs grow, and learn the card game SET only after many distinct questions, although attention can represent both. We read these failures, and the uneven record of higher-order attention, from what a layer sums over: each layer we study computes the partition function of a family of witnesses and reads it at a temperature. Two laws follow. The depth law is a known result of logic, which we state for these layers: L layers over two-step walks reach exactly 2^L - 1 steps, just as a logical statement with L nested clauses of the form "there is a vertex such that" sees exactly that far. We build a construction that reaches this far, checked in Lean, and, when vertices carry no names, no such network reaches further. The size law is the cost of reading at a temperature, which logic does not have: existence is read correctly at every size, in the worst case, if and only if inverse temperature times margin is at least the logarithm of the number of candidates. Layers built on these laws, and on two principles that we test, learn where Transformers fail. One propagator layer trained on 49-vertex graphs answers every question at every search depth on 250-vertex graphs. Given the modulus 3, exponential Newton computes the softmax of 2-simplicial attention over pairs exactly in 3^d n operations for d clocks; with six clocks it learns SET from as few deals as 2-simplicial attention and transfers from 8- to 20-card tables. On CLRS-30 without hints, a 186,000-parameter block of OR-join and power-mean channels matches (within half a point) or beats a model of at least 73 million parameters on 9 of 12 graph tasks of the official test set, and on 8 of 12 with freshly drawn test graphs. The same account explains where pair layers did not help and where parallel layers must loop.

</details>


### [347] [A Trust Region Approach for Learning Schrödinger Bridges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11649)
*Takeshi Koshizuka,Denis Blessing,Max Zimmer,Sebastian Pokutta,Lorenz Richter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对仅有未归一化目标密度、无法获得目标分布样本的情形，提出带信赖域约束的迭代比例拟合方法，以提升数值稳定性，并将其解释为采用自适应步长的镜像下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在目标分布样本不可用时，迭代比例拟合及其变体仍可用于近似求解薛定谔桥，但可能因底层控制问题条件不佳，以及最优解与初始点相距较远而产生严重数值不稳定。本文旨在缓解这些问题。

Method: 在迭代比例拟合的连续更新之间加入信赖域约束，要求每次更新与当前迭代点之间的相对熵保持在固定范围内，从而限制更新幅度、改善稳定性。作者进一步证明，该方法可解释为一种采用自适应步长的镜像下降算法。

Result: 摘要报告，该方法显著改善了数值稳定性，并在多个具有挑战性的采样任务上展示了有效性；摘要未提供具体实验指标或与基线方法的定量比较。

Conclusion: 通过限制相邻迭代点之间的相对熵距离，可以提升仅凭未归一化目标密度求解薛定谔桥时的数值稳定性。该信赖域方法还具有自适应步长镜像下降的理论解释。

Abstract: We study the numerical approximation of Schrödinger Bridges in the setting where samples from the target distribution are unavailable and only an unnormalized target density is given.
