We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.

</details>


### [383] [When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11881)
*Anna Lazareva,Alexander Tarakanov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将交通流守恒定律融入估计模型，可提升稀疏传感器条件下的交通状态重建能力，尤其能更稳健地处理拥堵波与交通冲击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通状态估计需要依据少量传感器数据，推断未监测位置的交通密度。现有数据驱动方法在传感器覆盖稀疏时性能明显下降，因此研究希望借助交通流的物理规律提升数据利用效率，并改善对未观测位置的泛化能力。

Method: 以朗利—惠特姆—理查兹交通流守恒定律作为物理先验，构建物理信息约束的交通状态估计器，并在四个真实交通走廊数据集上与传统及深度克里金插值、无物理约束网络进行比较。研究还通过匹配的平滑先验和基于同一守恒模型的扩展卡尔曼滤波，检验性能提升的来源；另提出损失条件化的物理信息神经网络，以减少逐走廊搜索损失权重的成本。

Result: 在传感器留出比例较高时，数据驱动方法容易对已观测传感器过拟合，而物理信息方法在未观测位置上泛化更好。在拥堵波较多的走廊中，当留出比例达到百分之八十五至九十时，物理信息估计器比无物理约束网络约好百分之二十六至三十八；留出百分之九十时，比最强的传统克里金方法约好百分之十至二十一。单纯平滑先验无法复现这一优势；在拥堵波走廊上，扩展卡尔曼滤波也不及该估计器。损失条件化模型则以约五分之一的计算成本，达到二十点搜索的相近效果。

Conclusion: 交通流守恒定律能为稀疏传感器下的交通状态估计提供有效约束，且其收益并非来自一般性的平滑，而与守恒规律的具体施加方式有关。该方法尤其适用于交通状态变化剧烈、传感器覆盖不足的场景；损失条件化设计还可降低模型调参成本。

Abstract: Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

</details>


### [384] [How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11887)
*Yong Hwi Song,Keon Myung Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文系统比较一步随机世界模型的训练目标，发现最近邻多样本匹配在离散、多模态未来预测上效果突出且推理更快；同时揭示其记忆、模式概率变平及高维连续结果欠分散等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性特征预测器容易把多个可能未来平均成不真实的结果；扩散和流匹配虽能建模随机性，却需要每步进行多次网络计算。近期研究认为，简单的最近邻多样本匹配只需较少候选样本，并可能优于能量评分目标。本文通过可枚举未来的基准检验这些主张，并分析该目标的适用边界。

Method: 在冻结的视觉特征标记上训练一步世界模型，比较最近邻多样本匹配、流匹配、一步流生成器和能量评分生成器。作者将最近邻多样本目标解释为：从生成器抽取多个样本构成随机码本，其对真实未来的期望失真；据此预先提出并验证关于记忆效应、模式概率变化和连续高维结果欠分散的预测。此外，研究在模型自身生成的轨迹上逐步匹配，并通过消融分析其长时域效果。

Result: 在类似离散模式的不确定性下，取十六个候选样本的最近邻匹配，比五十步流匹配更全面地覆盖可枚举未来，延迟约为其三十分之一；它也优于参数量相当的一步流生成器和能量评分生成器，且生成轨迹更贴近视觉特征标记流形。实验还发现：在上下文不重复时，该目标会记忆已实现结果，其程度由码本漏失失真而非单纯漏失概率控制，增大样本数无法使能量评分生成器免于这一问题；模式概率随候选数增加而趋于平坦，符合理论最优值；在真实机器人视频的连续高维结果上则存在欠分散。逐步匹配使随机推挤任务的长时域误差降低约三分之一，但规划成功率没有提升，尽管风险估计准确。

Conclusion: 最近邻多样本匹配是计算高效、适合多模态离散未来的一步随机世界模型目标，但候选数会影响失真、模式概率和记忆行为，且该方法在连续高维预测中受到欠分散限制。更准确的预测与风险估计也不必然转化为更好的规划表现；应用时需结合任务结构，并针对规划失败另行诊断。

Abstract: One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

</details>


### [385] [On the Global Convergence of Stochastic Adam for Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11905)
*Yihang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为阿当优化器训练足够宽的双层神经网络及求解泊松方程的物理信息神经网络，建立了全批量和小批量情形下的几何收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿当优化器在实践中常能将训练损失降至接近零，但其理论分析比梯度下降更困难：一阶动量将不同时刻的随机梯度耦合起来，自适应预条件项又依赖当前更新所用的随机梯度。已有神经切线核分析未充分解决这些问题，尤其缺少适用于小批量训练及物理信息神经网络的收敛保证。

Method: 针对全批量训练，构造李雅普诺夫函数以控制历史动量的影响。针对小批量训练，采用精确的虚拟迭代表示，条件化分析随机梯度与自适应预条件项之间的依赖关系，并对二阶矩估计建立一致集中界。在此基础上，将分析扩展至求解泊松方程的物理信息神经网络，处理微分算子以及内部点和边界点分别采样带来的困难，并给出网络宽度、优化器参数和小批量规模的显式条件。

Result: 对于足够宽的双层神经网络，证明全批量阿当优化器的经验损失几何衰减；小批量情形下，则在高概率事件上证明损失在受限期望意义下几何衰减。对于泊松方程的物理信息神经网络，也为确定性和随机阿当优化器建立了相应的全局收敛保证，并刻画小批量规模对收敛的影响。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上解释了阿当优化器在特定神经网络训练任务中的快速损失下降，并将保证扩展到物理信息神经网络。研究弥合了该优化器实践表现与理论理解之间的差距，也为泊松方程求解提供了比既有分析更强的收敛结论。

Abstract: The Adam optimizer is widely used to train neural networks with highly nonlinear and nonconvex objective functions. Remarkably, Adam often drives the empirical training loss nearly to zero. This phenomenon has been partially explained by neural tangent kernel (NTK) analyses of gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD). However, analyzing Adam presents additional challenges. Its first-moment momentum couples stochastic gradients across iterations, while its adaptive second-moment preconditioner depends on the same stochastic gradient used in the update. In this paper, we establish linear convergence guarantees for Adam in training sufficiently wide two-layer neural networks with either full-batch or minibatch gradients. For full-batch Adam, we construct a Lyapunov function to control the effect of historical momentum. For minibatch Adam, our analysis builds on an exact virtual-iterate representation, a conditional analysis of the dependence between stochastic gradients and adaptive preconditioners, and uniform concentration bounds for the second-moment estimates. We prove geometric decay of the empirical loss for full-batch Adam and geometric decay in restricted expectation on a high-probability event for minibatch Adam. Beyond regression, we extend our convergence analysis to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving the Poisson equation, where differential operators and separate sampling of interior and boundary points introduce additional challenges. We establish analogous global convergence guarantees for both deterministic and stochastic Adam under explicit conditions on network width and Adam's parameters, characterizing the effects of minibatch size on convergence. These results help bridge the gap between Adam's empirical success and its theoretical understanding, providing sharper convergence guarantees for PINNs than existing analyses.

</details>


### [386] [CRAFT-GBM: Selecting Best Features for Gradient-Boosted Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11914)
*Basil Kuok,Yi Zhou,Yao Xuan,Shuping Li,Ke-Wei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种依据训练中分裂增益证据动态筛选特征的方法，在提供统计保证的同时减少梯度提升树的训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征子采样通常预先固定筛选数量，且未充分利用训练过程中逐步积累的分裂增益信息。因此，筛选规模可能不适应数据和训练状态，难以兼顾计算效率与预测性能。

Method: 该方法将根节点分裂增益转换为有界观测，并构造适用于自适应、非平稳训练过程的联合时间一致置信界。默认模式不预设特征比例，而是在每轮保留尚不能排除为最优的特征，使筛选数量随训练证据动态变化；以至少 1−δ 的概率，在初始化后的所有轮次中共同保留期望增益最大的特征。若预先指定特征比例，则按区间点估计排序，并提供近似的前若干名特征保证。该方法集成于原生梯度提升实现，并保留其特征捆绑表示。

Result: 在涵盖 14 类公开及合成数据集、并包含 4 种噪声增强设置的评估中，默认动态模式在全部 18 项实验的几何平均结果上，使单次拟合训练时间降低 39.74%，测试损失仅增加 1.04%。指定特征比例时，该方法相较随机特征子采样，汇总训练时间降幅最多多出 13.52 个百分点，且汇总测试损失未高于使用全部特征的基线。

Conclusion: 训练过程中积累的分裂增益证据能够用于自适应特征搜索，并可配合统计保证减少计算开销。实验结果表明，该方案在动态选择特征数量或遵循预设特征预算时，均具有实际效率优势，同时总体维持了有竞争力的预测表现。

Abstract: Feature subsampling is used to accelerate gradient-boosted trees, yet standard approaches fix the feature count in advance and largely ignore the split-gain evidence accumulated during training. We introduce CRAFT-GBM (Confidence-Ranked Adaptive Feature Tracking), a native LightGBM extension that uses this evidence to adapt which---and, by default, how many---features are searched each boosting round. CRAFT-GBM transforms root-split gains into bounded observations and constructs joint time-uniform bounds valid under adaptive, non-stationary training histories. In its default endogenous mode, after initialization, CRAFT-GBM retains exactly the features that cannot yet be ruled out as best, letting the selected feature-set size $K_t$ emerge from training history rather than a pre-specified fraction. With probability at least $1-δ$, every feature with the largest expected gain is retained jointly across all rounds after initialization. When a feature fraction $f$ is specified instead, CRAFT-GBM ranks features by their interval point estimates and provides an approximate top-$K$ guarantee for feature budget $K_f$. We implement CRAFT-GBM within LightGBM while preserving its native feature-bundling representation, and evaluate it across 14 public and synthetic dataset families and four noise-augmented settings. In the fully endogenous setting, CRAFT-GBM reduces per-fit training time by 39.74\% with 1.04\% lower test loss in the geometric mean across all 18 RQ1 experiments. Under pre-specified feature fraction $f$, Exogenous CRAFT-GBM also yields aggregate training-time reductions up to 13.52 percentage points larger than random feature subsampling, with no increase in aggregate test loss relative to full-feature LightGBM. Accumulated training evidence can thus support adaptive feature search with statistical guarantees while retaining the practical advantages of native gradient boosting.

</details>


### [387] [LBSNet: Lightweight Brain State Modeling via Learnable Spectral Prototypes for EEG-Based Fatigue Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11916)
*Kun Jia,Zhenyu Cao,Hanlin Yu,Zeyuan Li,Yixuan Liu,Zhongye Xia,Sen Song,Zhiyuan Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种轻量级脑电疲劳检测网络，通过频谱原型引导时间加权，使不同时间窗的贡献由其跨频带谱模式决定；跨被试实验显示其优于七种基线方法，且计算开销较低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疲劳检测既需要提取不同频带的频谱信息，也需要建模这些信息随时间的变化。现有方法虽结合了多频带建模与自适应时间处理，但尚未充分研究跨频带谱结构如何影响各时间片段对最终预测的贡献。

Method: 模型先通过分频带时间卷积、共享空间投影和跨频带重校准提取紧凑特征。随后，在每个时间窗内将相对频谱活动编码为归一化描述，并与可学习的频谱原型进行软匹配。原型分配结果与原型重要性共同生成时间权重，用于加权汇总功率特征，使每个时间窗的谱模式能够调节其对预测的影响。

Result: 在两个数据集上的跨被试实验中，该方法优于七种对比基线，同时保持较低计算成本。消融实验和可视化分析支持原型引导时间加权的有效性；学得的原型还显示，随着疲劳加深，相对跨频带谱状态会逐步重新分布。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将局部跨频带谱结构与时间聚合相联系，有助于提升脑电疲劳检测效果。该轻量级方法兼顾性能与计算效率，且其原型表示可用于观察疲劳相关的频谱状态变化。

Abstract: EEG-based fatigue detection requires modeling spectral information across bands and its temporal variation. Recent methods combine multi-band modeling with adaptive temporal processing, yet how spectral structure across bands should influence the contribution of each temporal interval remains insufficiently explored. We propose LBSNet, a lightweight network that uses prototype-based brain-state modeling to link local spectral structure with temporal aggregation. LBSNet extracts compact multi-band features through band-specific temporal convolution, shared spatial projections, and cross-band recalibration. Within each window, relative spectral activity is encoded as a normalized descriptor and softly matched to learnable spectral prototypes. Prototype assignments and learned prototype importance jointly determine temporal weights for power aggregation, allowing the spectral pattern of each window to guide its contribution to the prediction. Subject-independent experiments on SEED-VIG and SADT show that LBSNet outperforms seven baselines while maintaining low computational cost. Ablation and visualization analyses support prototype-guided temporal weighting, while the learned prototypes reveal a gradual redistribution of relative cross-band spectral states with increasing fatigue. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zy0929/LBSNet.

</details>


### [388] [Constrained Variational Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11936)
*Shuchang Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向混合动作空间的受约束变分策略优化方法，通过奖励—成本重加权与分解式策略拟合，在满足成本约束的同时改善回报表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合动作空间同时包含离散模式选择和依赖模式的连续控制，且需满足长时域成本约束。现有方法通常直接在参数空间优化因子化策略；原有受约束变分策略优化框架则针对连续动作，尚未解决混合动作下的策略改进与投影问题。

Method: 将变分优化框架扩展至混合动作空间：在约束期望步中，通过奖励与成本的指数重加权构造离散—连续联合目标分布；在参数化步中，利用混合动作的精确相对熵分解，分别在离散策略和条件连续策略的信赖域内拟合该目标。理论上，作者证明在有界性和严格可行条件下，约束期望步的对偶间隙为零；对精确更新给出固定参考策略下的替代目标改进及条件奖励—成本界，对近似更新则建立对偶极小值存在性，并以残差判定是否投影目标分布。

Result: 消融实验表明，考虑成本的重加权有助于控制约束成本。模拟混合控制环境中的大量实验显示，该方法相较混合动作基线取得了较有利的回报—成本权衡。

Conclusion: 该方法将非参数策略改进与参数化策略投影结合，系统地处理离散模式和条件连续控制，并提供相应的理论保障与实验证据。其结果说明，在混合动作约束强化学习中，显式利用成本信息构造目标分布是控制成本、兼顾回报的有效途径。

Abstract: Constrained reinforcement learning in hybrid action spaces must coordinate discrete modes and mode-conditioned continuous controls under long-horizon cost constraints. Existing constrained hybrid-action methods typically optimize factorized policies directly in parameter space, whereas Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (CVPO) separates nonparametric improvement from parametric projection in its original continuous-action formulation. We introduce Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending this variational framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, its constrained E-step has zero duality gap and, when the dual optimum is attained at positive temperature, yields a closed-form joint target distribution over hybrid actions through exponential reward-cost reweighting. Using the exact hybrid KL decomposition, we formulate a factorized M-step that fits both policy components to this target under separate discrete and conditional-continuous trust regions. For exact E/M updates, we prove fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds with a sufficient feasibility-margin condition. For approximate updates, we establish the existence of a dual minimizer under continuity on a compact domain and use residual-based admissibility to determine whether to project the target. Ablations identify cost-aware reweighting as an important contributor to constraint control. Extensive experiments in simulated hybrid-control environments show that H-CVPO achieves favorable reward-cost trade-offs compared with hybrid-action baselines.

</details>


### [389] [Decision Aware Origin-Destination Demand Estimation with Structurally Constrained Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11946)
*Xianzhe Wang,Yueyue Fan,Johannes Royset*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向决策的起讫点需求估计框架，在满足交通数据与网络约束的前提下，优先选择能降低后续决策后悔值的需求估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统起讫点需求估计主要关注估计值与观测交通数据及历史需求是否吻合，但数据拟合良好并不必然带来良好的交通规划与管理决策。估计误差对后续决策质量的影响同样重要，因此需要将决策表现纳入估计目标。

Method: 利用受物理网络约束的交通数据刻画可接受的需求区域，并通过几何表示近似该区域，以缩小可行需求估计的搜索范围。在此范围内，采用后续决策后悔值的凸近似，构建可求解的面向决策优化问题，从而兼顾数据一致性与决策相关性。

Result: 数值实验表明，与传统需求估计基准方法相比，该框架能够持续降低后续决策的后悔值，说明将需求估计与决策质量对齐具有实际价值。

Conclusion: 起讫点需求估计不应仅以数据拟合程度衡量，还应考虑估计结果对下游决策的影响。本文框架通过在可接受需求范围内优化后悔值，实现了数据一致且有助于提升决策质量的需求估计。

Abstract: Origin-destination (OD) demand plays an important role in transportation system design and management applications. Conventional OD estimation methods typically judge estimation quality based on how estimated demand aligns with observed traffic data and historical demand patterns. We argue that data alignment alone is insufficient; how errors in OD estimates influence downstream decision quality should also be considered. This paper develops a decision aware OD demand estimation framework that leverages structurally constrained traffic data to characterize an admissible demand region, within which we identify OD estimates that would lead to least regret in the downstream decision. Therefore, our OD estimates are both data-consistent and decision-relevant. Methodologically, we approximate the admissible demand region induced by physical network constraints through a geometric representation, which regularizes the search over feasible OD estimates. Within this regularized region, we use a convex surrogate of downstream regret to obtain a tractable decision aware optimization problem. Numerical experiments show that the proposed framework consistently reduces decision regret relative to conventional estimation benchmarks, demonstrating the value of aligning OD demand estimation with downstream decision quality.

</details>


### [390] [Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11960)
*Guoqing Zhang,Rafik Hadfi,Takayuki Ito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种融合患者临床信息与医院运行状况的重症监护病房出院风险评估系统；端到端多模态微调表现最佳，说明运营指标和经过适当处理的文本信息有助于预测非计划再入院。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测模型多聚焦患者自身的病理生理状态，较少考虑医院床位周转压力、科室工作负荷和患者流动等运营因素。然而，出院决策往往是在患者稳定性与资源压力之间作出的动态权衡。因此，研究旨在将医院运行背景纳入重症监护病房出院风险评估，并改善非计划三十日再入院的预测能力。

Method: 研究构建了具备运营感知能力的多模态临床决策支持系统。系统通过多智能体协作提取与自演进检索增强生成处理病程记录，减少模板噪声；同时整合科室工作负荷、入院流动特征、连续生命体征及稀疏的诊断和疾病分组编码。针对再入院比例约为百分之十点五造成的类别不平衡及警报疲劳，采用数据归一化、类别加权和决策阈值校准。端到端微调模型还使用分层参数冻结与差异化学习率。

Result: 在两万例重症监护住院记录上进行二十次独立实验。仅使用生命体征时，精确率—召回率曲线下面积为零点一三八七，预测能力有限；直接拼接原始文本嵌入会使树模型表现下降，极端梯度提升与轻量级梯度提升的该项指标分别降至零点三八九三和零点四零三零。相比之下，端到端多模态微调模型表现最佳：受试者工作特征曲线下面积为零点八二八八，精确率—召回率曲线下面积为零点四三七三，调和平均值为零点四七五七。实验还显示，运营指标能够提供独立的风险信号。

Conclusion: 研究表明，重症监护病房再入院风险评估不宜只依赖患者个体临床状态，还应纳入医院运营背景。未经适当融合的文本嵌入可能造成负迁移，而采用端到端微调及相应训练策略能够缓解这一问题并取得更好的综合预测表现。运营指标为构建更具实用价值的临床决策支持工具提供了工程基础；不过，摘要未提供外部验证或临床部署效果，因此其跨机构泛化能力与实际应用收益仍需进一步评估。

Abstract: Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. In 20 independent runs across 20,000 ICU stays from MIMIC-III, empirical findings demonstrate that: vital signs alone have limited predictive capacity under real-world class imbalance (PR-AUC of 0.1387 +/- 0.0086); directly concatenating raw text embeddings degrades decision tree performance (XGBoost and LightGBM PR-AUC drop to 0.3893 and 0.4030); whereas an end-to-end multimodal fine-tuning architecture (Transformer E2E FineTune) utilizing layer-wise parameter freezing and differential learning rates reverses text negative transfer, achieving the highest AUROC of 0.8288 +/- 0.0110, PR-AUC of 0.4373 +/- 0.0310, and F1-Score of 0.4757 +/- 0.0196. Operational indicators supply independent risk signals, laying an engineering foundation for high-utility clinical decision support tools.

</details>


### [391] [Pairwise distortion distribution for compression and quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11967)
*Carl Nuzman,Jeongmin Chae,Kursat Rasim Mestav,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出成对失真分布及其渐近维数，用于连接数据的内在维度与压缩性能，并为量化和降维提供指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 压缩中潜在维度的选择至关重要，但传统超参数优化成本高且缺乏统一依据。已有内在维度概念与信息维数、率失真维数及随机码本压缩有关，但需要一种能适用于一般失真度量的分析工具。

Method: 提出成对失真分布，描述数据点对之间的失真，并定义其渐近极限——成对维数。该框架将相关积分推广到一般失真度量，并分析成对维数、信息维数与随机码本量化性能之间的关系。

Result: 理论上证明，成对维数为信息维数提供界限；成对失真分布则为随机码本量化性能提供下界。摘要未报告具体实验或数值结果。

Conclusion: 成对失真分布及成对维数为评估数据内在结构和压缩能力提供了统一的理论工具，有望辅助压缩、量化与降维中的维度选择和性能分析。

Abstract: Choosing the latent dimension is a critical challenge in data compression, where conventional hyperparameter optimization is costly and ad hoc. Intrinsic dimension provides a good alternative, which connects information-theoretic notions such as Renyi information dimension (RID) to rate-distortion dimension and random codebook compression. In this work, we introduce the pairwise distortion distribution (PDD) and its asymptotic limit, pairwise dimension (PD), which generalize the correlation integral to general distortion measures. We show that PD bounds RID, and PDD provides a lower bound for random codebook quantization performance, which can guide a practical use for compression, quantization, and dimensionality reduction applications.

</details>


### [392] [ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11976)
*Sina Barazandeh,Arth Banka,Jose Lugo-Martinez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“移位缓存”方法，针对插入和缺失变异复用可共享的编码器计算，在多变异共享窗口时显著加速评分，同时保持预测结果与密集计算一致；但加速效果取决于变异分布和计算设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列到功能模型需要比较参考序列与变异序列的预测。插入或缺失会使其后未改变的序列相对模型的汇聚网格发生偏移，导致参考序列的编码器中间结果难以直接复用，因此每个变异往往需要重复执行大量计算。既有大规模分析为此付出了高昂的计算成本。

Method: 移位缓存针对同一窗口、具有相同移位长度的多个变异，只对每种移位后的参考序列编码一次，并在变异间共享结果。对于每个变异，方法复制其可复用的编码器输出，再将其余部分划分为批量区块重新计算。满足特定条件的编码器可实现与密集计算在精确算术下完全相同的预测。

Result: 在包含大量共享窗口变异的阿尔法基因组测试数据上，单张A六千显卡以严格单精度运行时，移位缓存比去重后的密集计算快三点五至六点五倍，比适配于插入和缺失的逐层复用方法快一点六至二点七倍。相比两项已发表分析的博尔佐伊和阿尔法基因组密集实现，速度快三点五至四点一倍；相比恩福默密集计算快二点六倍。若每个变异单独使用居中的一百三十一千碱基窗口，优势缩小至一点三六倍；插入长度高度多样或编辑分散时，该方法可能不如逐层复用或密集计算。默认模型运行中，已检查输出与密集计算的绝对及相对误差均不超过十的负五次方；增大区块批量、使用恩福默或H一百显卡时，少数值会超过该误差界限。

Conclusion: 移位缓存利用插入和缺失变异之间的结构性重叠，能显著减少序列到功能模型的重复编码计算，并在适用条件下维持预测一致性。其实际收益取决于窗口内变异的共享程度、移位长度的多样性、编辑分布及硬件和批量设置，因此应结合具体工作负载选择。

Abstract: Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. We present ShiftCache, an exact reuse system that encodes each shifted reference once and shares it among all variants scored in the same window with the same shift. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. On held-out AlphaGenome windows shared by many indels, in strict fp32 on one A6000, ShiftCache is 3.5 to 6.5$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution and 1.6 to 2.7$\times$ faster than our adaptation of layer-by-layer reuse to indels. It is 3.5 to 4.1$\times$ faster than dense reimplementations of two published analyses with Borzoi and AlphaGenome, and 2.6$\times$ faster than dense execution with Enformer. Scoring each variant in its own centered 131 kb window makes ShiftCache only 1.36$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution, and highly diverse insertion lengths or many dispersed edits can make it slower than layer-by-layer reuse or dense execution. For encoders that meet our conditions, ShiftCache computes the same predictions as dense execution in exact arithmetic. On an A6000, every checked output of the default AlphaGenome and Borzoi runs matches dense execution within an absolute and relative tolerance of $10^{-5}$. With larger tile batches, with Enformer or on an H100, a small fraction of values exceeds this tolerance.

</details>


### [393] [HyInv Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11997)
*Haowei Lin,Cai Zhou,Xiangxin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种高效的蛋白质逆折叠模型：在给定蛋白质骨架时生成氨基酸序列，并在多个基准上取得较高的折叠质量与序列多样性，同时显著提升生成速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质逆折叠需要为给定骨架设计序列。实际筛选往往要求同时生成大量彼此多样、且能够正确折叠的候选序列；现有方法在质量、多样性和推理效率之间仍有改进空间。

Method: 提出一种约含一百九十六万参数、以骨架为条件的图网络，采用编码器—解码器架构。训练分两阶段：先进行随机顺序的自回归序列建模预训练，再通过结构奖励强化学习优化。推理时采用分组式“起草—改写”采样，并分别设置两阶段温度，以提升在相同多样性下的再折叠结构评分。实现方面使用十六位脑浮点数值计算加速，并保留可精确复现参考序列的三十二位单精度路径。

Result: 在五个基准数据集和七种数据集—预测器组合上，该方法的平均结构相似性评分高于十个外部基线，且序列多样性相当或更高；相较于蛋白质消息传递网络和蛋白质零二代，优势尤其明显。单张英伟达H20显卡上，为一个含四百零二个残基的骨架生成一百二十八条序列仅需五十点六毫秒，约为参考采样器的五十二倍速；精确复现参考序列的路径也快八点七倍。默认设置还适用于从头设计、口袋约束序列库、保留催化位点的酶改造及环区改造。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了将结构奖励强化学习与分阶段采样结合，能够兼顾逆折叠设计的折叠质量、多样性和速度。模型在多类设计任务和基准测试中表现稳健，具有支持大规模候选筛选的潜力。

Abstract: Inverse folding designs amino-acid sequences for a given protein backbone, and screening needs many candidates that are both diverse and well folded. We present HyInv, a 1.96-million-parameter backbone-conditioned graph network with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team: pretrained with random-order autoregressive sequence modeling, followed by structure-reward reinforcement learning. At inference, a grouped draft-and-rewrite sampler that uses separate draft and rewrite temperatures improves refolding TM-score at matched diversity. An optimized implementation with BF16 numerics designs 128 sequences for a 402-residue backbone in 50.6 ms on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, about 52 times faster than the reference sampler, and an exact FP32 path that returns the reference sequences is 8.7 times faster. Across five benchmark datasets and seven dataset-predictor combinations, HyInv reaches a higher average scTM than all ten external baselines at comparable or higher sequence diversity, with large margins over ProteinMPNN and ProteinZero V2. The same default setting supports de novo backbones, pocket-constrained libraries, enzyme redesign with the catalytic site kept, and loop redesign. We have released our code and model at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv.

</details>


### [394] [Reward-Estimated Hypergradient for Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Black-Box Follower](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11998)
*Shigeki Kusaka,Mikoto Kudo,Takumi Tanabe,Akifumi Wachi,Youhei Akimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种利用跟随者轨迹反推其奖励函数、进而估计双层强化学习超梯度的方法，并通过聚合多种动力学下的估计与截断小特征值来缓解奖励歧义和有限样本不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双层强化学习超梯度方法通常假设领导者已知跟随者的奖励函数，但现实中领导者往往只能观察跟随者的行为轨迹。逆强化学习虽可从轨迹推断奖励，却只能确定到势函数塑形所造成的等价变换；这种变换不影响跟随者行为，却可能使超梯度产生偏差。

Method: 提出基于奖励估计的超梯度方法：先用逆强化学习从跟随者轨迹估计线性奖励，再计算超梯度。作者证明，在动力学足够多样时，汇总不同动力学下的奖励估计可抵消势函数塑形带来的偏差，而领导者自身的更新会自然促成这种多样性。针对有限样本导致的估计不稳，方法截断汇总特征协方差矩阵中的小特征值，以恢复可辨识子空间并稳定估计。

Result: 实验显示，该方法估计的梯度与已知真实奖励时得到的基准梯度方向一致，且取得了相近的性能。截断小特征值还抑制了超梯度爆炸，使该方法在尖锐奖励景观中能够避开基准方法容易陷入的局部最优。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，即使领导者不知道跟随者的奖励函数，也可以借助轨迹、跨动力学的奖励估计聚合及特征值截断，获得有效且稳定的超梯度估计，为更符合实际的黑箱双层强化学习提供了方法。

Abstract: Hypergradient (HG) methods for bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) typically assume a white-box follower whose reward is known. In practice, however, the leader rarely knows the follower's reward function and can only observe its trajectories. We address this black-box setting and propose Reward-Estimated Hypergradients (RE-HG), which recovers the follower's reward from these trajectories via inverse RL (IRL). Yet IRL identifies the reward only up to potential-based shaping, a transformation that leaves the follower's behavior unchanged but biases the HG. We prove that, for linear rewards, this bias cancels when IRL estimates are aggregated across sufficiently diverse dynamics, which the leader's own updates naturally supply. To handle finite samples, RE-HG truncates small eigenvalues of the aggregated feature covariance, restoring the identifiable subspace and stabilizing the estimation. Experiments show that RE-HG estimates gradients aligned with a white-box Oracle and achieves comparable performance; empirically, the truncation also suppresses HG explosions, letting RE-HG avoid local optima that trap the Oracle in sharp reward landscapes.

</details>


### [395] [HyPLM Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12000)
*Haowei Lin,Cai Zhou,Xiangxin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一款高效的蛋白质语言模型，在显著降低训练与推理成本的同时，整体性能达到同规模先进模型水平，并在长程接触预测等任务上表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型已广泛用于变异效应预测、蛋白质注释和设计，但模型训练与部署所需的计算资源持续增加。本文旨在降低计算开销，同时维持具有竞争力的预测性能。

Method: 研究团队利用其研发的智能体训练了掩码语言模型“海普莱姆闪电”，模型规模为六点五亿参数，使用七千二百六十亿个词元训练。团队还为其构建了高效推理引擎，采用融合计算内核与八位整数矩阵乘法，以提高推理速度、降低计算成本。

Result: 在与二十八个公开模型、共三十二项任务的对比中，该模型的蛋白质零样本斯皮尔曼相关系数为零点四零九，与同规模先进模型在统计上相当；在自监督单序列模型中，生物体适应度得分最高。其长程接触精度优于所有受测模型，包括参数规模更大的模型；在保留序列和近期发布的蛋白质结构数据库链上，掩码残基损失也低于若干同规模对照模型。单张英伟达H二十图形处理器每秒可处理约十三万个残基，速度约为同级编码器的一点九至二点七倍。

Conclusion: 该模型以较少训练数据和较低推理成本，实现了与先进同规模模型相当的总体准确度，并在部分任务上取得领先表现。研究据此认为，它拓展了蛋白质语言模型在性能与计算成本之间的帕累托前沿；模型权重和推理引擎已公开发布。

Abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are standard tools for variant-effect prediction, protein annotation and design, but the compute needed to train and serve them keeps growing. We present HyPLM-Flash, an efficient and open PLM trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team. HyPLM-Flash is a 650-million-parameter masked language model trained on 726 billion tokens, 0.73 times the data of ESM-2 650M and a fifth to an eighth of the data of E1-600M and ESM C 600M. It runs on an inference engine with fused kernels and INT8 matrix multiplication, embedding about 130,000 residues per second on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, 1.9 to 2.7 times faster than other 600M-class encoders. In a matched evaluation against 28 public checkpoints on 32 tasks, HyPLM-Flash reaches a ProteinGym zero-shot Spearman correlation of 0.409, statistically tied with ESM-2 650M, ESM C 600M and E1-600M, and the highest organismal-fitness score among self-supervised single-sequence models. It gives the best long-range contact precision of all models evaluated, including ESM-2 15B and ESM C 6B, and a lower masked-residue loss than ESM-2 650M, ESM C 600M and E1-600M on held-out sequences and on recently released PDB chains. Matching state-of-the-art accuracy at a fraction of the training and inference cost, HyPLM-Flash sets a new Pareto frontier for protein language models. We have released the model weights and the inference engine at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/hyra-results/tree/main.

</details>


### [396] [Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12010)
*Panagiotis Krokidas,Christos Lazaridis,Vassilis Sioros,Efi-Maria Papia,Vassilios Constantoudis,George Giannakopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出一种可扩展的贝叶斯优化框架，用于从大型材料设计空间中高效寻找高性能构型；在六层旋转六角晶格形成的摩尔图案任务中，该方法以远少于随机搜索的评估次数找到全局最优构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料设计空间规模庞大，性能优异的构型可能十分稀少。依赖反复试验或代表性机器学习抽样，往往难以发现这类构型；而计算成本高、目标分布高度偏斜的问题，也会使传统贝叶斯优化方法难以实际应用。因此，需要兼顾搜索效率与计算可扩展性的优化框架。

Method: 提出灵活的贝叶斯优化框架，并以六个相互旋转的六角晶格叠加形成的摩尔图案作为案例。设计目标是最大化孔径均匀性，并以耶恩公平性指数进行量化。研究在包含六十万个独特构型的基准上，对比随机搜索、高斯过程代理模型贝叶斯优化，以及采用轻量级梯度提升树代理模型和委员会式不确定性估计的贝叶斯优化。

Result: 随机搜索经过五十三万三千零一十二次评估、约三十一小时后才找到全局最优构型。高斯过程贝叶斯优化在获取二百九十个样本后因显存耗尽而无法继续。所提出框架结合梯度提升树后，仅经一千四百七十次评估、约一点一五小时便找到全局最优构型。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在大型纳米材料设计空间中，采用计算开销较低且可扩展的代理模型，能够显著提升贝叶斯优化的可行性与搜索效率。该方法为应对目标分布偏斜、优异构型稀少的计算材料设计问题提供了有效思路。

Abstract: Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GPU memory exhaustion after 290 acquired samples. In contrast, FruBO with CatBoost identifies the global optimum after 1,470 acquired samples and approximately 1.15 hours. These results demonstrate that scalable surrogate models can substantially improve the feasibility and efficiency of BO in large nanomaterials design spaces.

</details>


### [397] [FocusBranch: Combinatorial Branch-and-Bound for $\ell_0$ Neural Network Robustness Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12024)
*Renwei Deng,Yang He,Linyi Li,Yuepeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出焦点分支框架，通过可分解的节点抽象和分支定界，验证神经网络在稀疏像素扰动下的局部鲁棒性，并在多种数据集与网络架构上优于现有验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ℓ₀扰动允许在像素间任意选择稀疏子集，因此鲁棒性验证需要处理组合数量庞大的扰动情形。现有方法若采用固定验证计划，难以灵活权衡验证效率与搜索范围。

Method: 框架以焦点像素集合和层级构造节点抽象，限制集合外可发生扰动的像素数量。具体节点通过逐步固定新增扰动位置进行分支；超节点则利用覆盖设计，以较少子节点覆盖多种扰动情形。方法将节点约束下的ℓ₀扰动集合代入线性松弛并具体化，以判定节点安全；对尚无法判定的节点递归分支。此外，框架抽样评估不同层级的安全率与验证成本，据此选择预计耗时较低的起始层级和分支策略。

Result: 在全连接和卷积分类器、手写数字、时尚物品及彩色图像数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够有效验证ℓ₀鲁棒性，并优于当时的先进验证器。摘要未提供具体性能提升幅度。

Conclusion: 焦点分支通过统一的节点抽象，将不同类型的组合分支策略纳入分支定界框架，并依据估算的安全率和成本自适应选择验证方案，为ℓ₀局部鲁棒性验证提供了有效方法。

Abstract: Verifying the local robustness of neural networks under $\ell_0$ perturbations is inherently combinatorial, as it must reason over all sparse subsets of $ε$ perturbed pixels. This paper presents FocusBranch, a combinatorial branch-and-bound framework for $\ell_0$ robustness verification. The key insight is to make the $\ell_0$-ball decomposable and branchable using a node abstraction, which consists of a focus pixel set $\mathcal{S}$ and a level $l$, permitting at most $ε-l$ pixels outside $\mathcal{S}$. This abstraction unifies two branching mechanisms: concrete nodes branch through upper shadows to fix additional perturbed locations, while super nodes branch through covering designs to cover many perturbation cases with fewer child nodes. FocusBranch proves node safety by concretizing linear relaxations over node-constrained $\ell_0$-balls and recursively branches on unknown nodes. Rather than relying on a fixed verification plan, it samples nodes across levels to estimate safe rates and costs, then selects a starting level and branching strategy predicted to minimize verification time. Experiments on fully connected and convolutional classifiers for MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 show that FocusBranch verifies $\ell_0$ robustness effectively across architectures and outperforms state-of-the-art verifiers. The code is available at: https://github.com/simpl-group/FocusBranch.

</details>


### [398] [MambaPD: Bidirectional Selective State Space Model for Parkinson's Disease Detection from Resting-State EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12026)
*Ayesha Zulfiqar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于静息态脑电的帕金森病检测模型，并以受试者独立交叉验证进行评估。结果显示，该模型与多个基线方法表现相近，整体准确率有限，且不同数据折之间的差异大于模型间差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帕金森病通常在多巴胺能神经元大量损失后才被诊断，而静息态脑电中的α波减慢、脑区间相干性降低等异常可能更早出现，因此脑电有望支持早期检测。既有研究常采用按脑电片段划分训练集和测试集的方式，可能造成受试者身份信息泄漏，使准确率被高估。本文旨在以受试者独立的评估方式检验脑电检测方法的实际表现。

Method: 提出一种双向选择性状态空间模型，将通道混合、脑电片段标记化和双向状态空间编码器结合起来。研究在两个公开数据集上采用受试者独立的五折交叉验证，并与时序卷积网络、带注意力的双向长短期记忆网络、脑电卷积网络及片段化变换器进行比较。作者同时报告逐折结果和完整流程，并指出模型检查点依据留出折选择，因此绝对性能估计偏乐观。

Result: 在规模较大的数据集上，各模型准确率约为0.67至0.71；所提模型准确率为0.714，与片段化变换器的0.715及时序卷积网络的0.708没有显著差异。所提模型敏感度最高，为0.82，但特异度最低之一，为0.52。在规模较小的数据集上，各模型准确率约为0.60至0.70；时序卷积网络最高，为0.703，所提模型为0.631，特异度为0.46，是五种模型中最低的。较大数据集上，模型间差异小于不同交叉验证折之间的差异。

Conclusion: 研究表明，所提模型在受试者独立评估下并未稳定优于常见基线方法，其表现还会随数据集和交叉验证折显著变化。结果提醒读者，对脑电疾病检测准确率应谨慎解读，并重视受试者级数据划分、逐折报告以及检查点选择等评估设计；由于检查点选择使用了留出折，本文报告的绝对性能仍可能偏乐观。

Abstract: Typical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) occurs only after significant dopaminergic loss, while resting-state EEG abnormalities like alpha slowing and reduced coherence occur earlier. While many published EEG-based PD detectors claim accuracy greater than 95%, many use epoch-level splits which leak subject identity. I introduce MambaPD, a bidirectional selective state space model for resting-state EEG-based PD detection, blending the channel mixing, patch tokenization and bidirectional Mamba encoder. It is compared with four baselines (TCN, BiLSTM with attention, EEGNet and a patch Transformer) in two public datasets (UNM, SanDiego) using subject-independent 5-fold cross-validation (checkpoints were selected on the held-out fold, so absolute estimates are optimistic). On UNM the accuracy is between 0.67 and 0.71, and MambaPD (0.714) is not statistically distinguishable from the Transformer (0.715), and TCN (0.708), with the highest sensitivity (0.82), while the lowest specificity (0.52). For the smaller SanDiego cohort, accuracy is in the range of 0.60 to 0.70, with the highest scores (0.703) from TCN and the lowest (0.601) from EEGNet, while MambaPD scores 0.631, with the lowest specificity (0.46) among the five models. The differences among the models on UNM are minor compared to the differences among folds. I report the whole pipeline, per-fold results, and the shortcomings of the protocol.

</details>


### [399] [Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12031)
*Shivam Pal,Piyush Rai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，针对线性整流单元网络的经验贝叶斯拉普拉斯近似会受到参数缩放对称性的影响，并提出规范化方法，使先验选择与预测不确定性对等价参数化保持一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性整流单元网络存在连续缩放对称性：不同权重参数可以表示同一函数，但其损失几何及海森矩阵可能不同。由于经验贝叶斯拉普拉斯近似依赖海森矩阵计算边际似然，它可能对这些等价参数化给出不同结果，导致先验精度、后验协方差和预测不确定性缺乏唯一性。

Method: 论文构造由参数 γ 索引的先验精度场，并提出 γ 规范化：先将网络转换为规范表示，使每个单元的输入权重与输出权重达到平衡，再在该表示上拟合经验贝叶斯拉普拉斯近似。此过程等价于将规范表示上的各向同性高斯先验迁移至原始坐标，从而得到与缩放对称性相容的先验精度场；γ 则通过最大化边际似然来选择。

Result: 该方法使边际似然对线性整流单元网络的缩放变换保持不变。对于表示同一函数的不同参数化，它能给出一致的先验精度选择、后验协方差及预测不确定性。

Conclusion: 通过在规范表示上进行近似并构造与缩放对称性相容的先验精度，经验贝叶斯拉普拉斯近似得以在缩放等价类上良好定义，避免了模型几何随参数化变化而造成的不一致。

Abstract: ReLU networks are well-known to have continuous scale symmetries; infinitely many reparameterized weight vectors that represent the same function. Dinh et al. (2017) have shown that, by reparameterizing, the geometry of the loss landscape (e.g., curvature) of these networks can be changed arbitrarily without affecting the underlying function. Thus, any quantity that depends on the network's geometry should be defined with care. In this paper, we show that the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace's approximation is not well-defined for ReLU networks, mainly due to Hessian dependence in computing the marginal likelihood, which is not invariant under ReLU scale symmetries. Thus, we can get different prior precisions, posterior covariances, and predictive uncertainties for a network having identical predictions under ReLU scaling. We define family of prior precision fields indexed by $γ$ and introduce $γ$-canonicalization, which first converts the network to its canonical representation by balancing the ratio of incoming to outgoing weights, and then fits the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace to the canonical representation. This procedure is equivalent to transporting the isotropic Gaussian prior from the canonical representation to the original coordinates, by producing a ReLU-scale-compatible precision field. This makes the marginal likelihood invariant under ReLU scaling, while allowing $γ$ to be selected by maximizing the marginal likelihood. The resulting EB Laplace approximation is well-defined on ReLU scale-equivalence classes and yields consistent prior precision selection and predictive uncertainties across functionally identical parameterizations.

</details>


### [400] [Exact Natarajan Dimension of Homogeneous Multiclass Linear Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12058)
*Jiahua Liu,Benchong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文精确确定了一类多分类线性预测器的纳塔拉詹维数为 n(k−1)−1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳塔拉詹维数是衡量多分类假设类容量的重要指标，有助于分析模型的泛化能力。论文旨在确定具有两两不同类别权重的齐次多分类线性预测器的精确维数。

Method: 通过分别建立该类预测器纳塔拉詹维数的下界和上界，并证明两者相等，得到其精确值。

Result: 当特征空间维数 n≥3、类别数 k≥3，且 n、k 为自然数时，该类预测器的纳塔拉詹维数为 n(k−1)−1。

Conclusion: 论文给出了上述多分类线性预测器容量的精确刻画，为评估其泛化能力提供了理论依据。

Abstract: The Natarajan dimension is a fundamental measure of the capacity of multiclass hypothesis classes and plays an important role in analyzing their generalization ability. In this paper, by establishing lower and upper bounds, we show that the exact Natarajan dimension of homogeneous multiclass linear predictors with pairwise distinct class weights is \(n(k-1)-1\), where $n$ is the dimension of the feature space and $k$ is the number of classes, for \(n,k\ge3\), \(n,k\in\mathbb N\).

</details>


### [401] [XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12067)
*Omar Hamdache,Serdar Kara,Kıvanç Kuzey Dikici,Abdullah Çağlar Öksüz,Anisa Halimi,Erman Ayday,Sinem Sav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出一种仅需单次查询的解释型成员推断攻击，利用模型解释估计样本与决策边界的距离，最高成功率可达百分之九十五。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习服务在提供预测结果时常同时发布解释，以提升透明度；但解释也可能泄露训练数据是否包含特定样本。论文关注这种额外的信息泄漏风险，尤其是解释能否被用来推断样本的成员身份。

Method: 提出解释型成员推断框架，利用局部代理模型的几何特征，将解释转换为目标样本与模型决策边界距离的估计，并据此判断样本是否属于训练集。该方法扩展至表格数据的反事实解释及图像分类器的视觉反事实解释。攻击前只需使用少量带标签样本进行一次校准，最少可用三十个样本；之后每个目标样本仅查询一次，只依赖预测标签及其解释，无需影子模型训练或多轮查询。

Result: 实验显示，该攻击具有较强效果，单次目标查询下的成功率最高达到百分之九十五。结果表明，解释所包含的决策边界线索可被有效用于成员身份推断。

Conclusion: 模型解释并非只有提升透明度的作用，也会构成新的隐私泄漏渠道。即使攻击者只能进行黑盒访问，且每个目标仅查询一次，公开预测及其解释仍可能暴露训练数据成员信息，因此发布解释时需要同时评估隐私风险。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. Our evaluation indicates that XposedMIA achieves high effectiveness, with success rates of up to 0.95 using only a single query per target, revealing that releasing explanations introduces an additional channel for membership leakage.

</details>


### [402] [Correct First, Fast Second: What a Local 7B Code Model Can and Cannot Do for GPU Kernel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12079)
*Jui-Chien Tsou,Po-Yi Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，对固定的本地七十亿参数代码模型而言，提示策略会显著影响算子替换表现；不过，正确性仍是主要瓶颈，复杂的多智能体流程并不必然带来提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文旨在厘清：在模型能力固定时，采用不同交互策略，能在多大程度上提升模型将深度学习框架算子替换为自定义图形处理器内核的能力。研究也关注多智能体流程是否优于更简单的提示方式，以及性能受限究竟来自策略还是模型本身。

Method: 研究使用本地部署的七十亿参数代码模型，在基准测试集的三十项任务上进行评估，并在英伟达伏特架构的图形处理器上测试。比较四种策略：零样本提示、基于性能分析结果的提示、依据实际执行反馈迭代修正，以及由同一模型分别承担分析、检索、生成和评估职责，并由非语言模型评估器提供反馈的多智能体流程。研究还测试了不同候选采样数量下的效果。

Result: 正确性是首要限制：即使只看正确内核，其平均速度也仅为原框架即时执行的零点九七至零点九九倍。性能提升主要出现在融合后的访存受限操作；对于稠密矩阵乘法和卷积，模型难以胜过成熟库。总体上，性能分析引导提示的表现最好，正确率为百分之四十三，较基线快百分之二十七；但只有多智能体流程解决了第二级融合任务，十项中完成三项，其他方法均为零项。未经调整的多智能体方案正确率仅百分之三，低于零样本提示的百分之三十；通过让任务难度匹配模型能力，并在真实执行评估器下增加候选采样，正确率从单个候选时的百分之三提升至八个候选时的百分之三十三。

Conclusion: 提升这类代码模型的内核生成能力，不应仅靠增加推理步骤或堆叠智能体角色。更有效的做法是依据任务难度选择策略、让方案符合模型能力，并将计算资源用于执行验证下的多候选搜索。即便如此，模型生成的正确内核也未必更快，性能优势目前主要局限于可融合的访存受限操作。

Abstract: We study how much the interaction strategy around a fixed, locally hosted 7B-parameter code model (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct) affects its ability to replace PyTorch operators with custom CUDA kernels. On 30 KernelBench tasks (levels 1-3, first 10 each, evaluated on a V100), we compare four regimes of increasing structure: zero-shot prompting, profiling-guided prompting, iterative refinement on execution feedback, and a multi-agent loop (analysis, retrieval, generation, evaluation, feedback triage) in which the same model fills four roles around a non-LLM evaluator. Three findings stand out. (1) Correctness, not speed, is the binding constraint: even correct generated kernels average 0.97-0.99x the speed of eager PyTorch, because a 7B model cannot out-write cuBLAS/cuDNN on dense GEMM and convolution; the only real wins are fused memory-bound epilogues. (2) The best strategy depends on difficulty: profiling-guided prompting is strongest overall (43% correct, 27% faster than baseline), but the agent loop is the only method that solves any level-2 fusion problem (3/10 vs. 0/10 for all others). (3) Naive agentic scaffolding is actively harmful: our first agent scored 3% correct, below zero-shot's 30%, and the decisive repairs were matching the agent's ambition to the model's competence and spending compute on best-of-n sampling under a real execution oracle (3% to 33% correct from n=1 to n=8), not on more reasoning steps.

</details>


### [403] [TSFFormer: A Frequency-Domain Spike Transformer for Green Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12090)
*Jiale Deng,Shuiying Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向可穿戴人体活动识别的纯脉冲傅里叶变换器，通过频域全局混合与双舱室时序脉冲神经元，兼顾识别精度、训练速度和低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴惯性测量设备适合持续、普遍地采集人体动作数据，但传统深度神经网络依赖密集浮点运算，存在计算延迟和能耗较高的问题。脉冲神经网络虽有低功耗优势，却仍面临空间信息交互不足、神经元适应性有限以及训练梯度衰减等挑战。

Method: 作者提出一种纯脉冲傅里叶变换器。其一，多头傅里叶注意力在频域进行全局信息混合，将复杂度由平方级降至对数线性级，改善空间信息交互并降低显存占用。其二，双舱室时序脉冲泄漏积分发放神经元采用动态阈值，以适应非平稳动作节律，并缓解梯度衰减。

Result: 在八个公开惯性测量数据集上的实验中，该方法优于现有脉冲神经网络及经典深度卷积长短期记忆模型。摘要报告其训练速度约快三倍，能耗达到每次操作零点一皮焦耳；消融实验也显示两项模块具有协同作用。摘要未提供各数据集的具体精度数值或完整比较条件。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，将频域全局混合与自适应时序脉冲神经元结合，有望缓解脉冲网络在可穿戴动作识别中的信息交互和训练难题，为高精度、低功耗的事件驱动感知提供了一种方案。其实际优势仍需结合硬件部署、能耗测量口径及跨场景泛化结果进一步评估。

Abstract: Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enable pervasive Human Activity Recognition (HAR), but traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) suffer from an "arithmetic-latency deadlock" due to dense floating-point MAC operations. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer ultra-low power, existing ones face spatial blind spots, rigid neurons, and gradient degradation. To address these, we propose TSFFormer, a purely spiking Fourier Transformer for Green HAR. It introduces two key innovations: (1) a MultiHeadFourier attention that performs frequency-domain global mixing, reducing complexity from \(O(V^2)\) to \(O(V\log V)\), eliminating spatial blind spots, and saving \(\sim\)50% GPU memory; and (2) a dual-compartment Temporal Spiking LIF (TSLIFNode) that utilizes dynamic thresholds to adapt to non-stationary rhythms and mitigate gradient degradation. Extensive experiments on 8 public IMU benchmarks demonstrate that TSFFormer surpasses state-of-the-art SNNs and even the classic DeepConvLSTM, achieving a \(\sim\)3\(\times\) faster training speed with an energy footprint of 0.1 pJ. Ablation studies confirm the synergistic effect of our modules, providing a highly accurate, ultra-low-power event-driven paradigm for wearable sensing.

</details>


### [404] [Forecast Value Add: Reward-Based Action Selection over Probabilistic Demand Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12116)
*Ankur Verma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将需求预测修正建模为基于奖励的决策问题，让智能体从集成模型已有的预测选项中择优，并用历史情境评估、季节性约束和贡献追踪提升预测准确性与可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使强大的机器学习集成模型能够捕捉需求趋势、季节性和已知事件，仍可能低估峰值、漏掉时间移动的事件，或把暂时变化误判为需求水平的长期转变。因此，需要一种能利用具体情境修正预测、又避免无依据调整的方法。

Method: 针对每个预测期，智能体从集成模型已有的候选值中作出选择，包括基础预测、无分布假设的上下界、分位数预测和偏差校正估计。候选方案依据情境匹配的历史时期进行评估，匹配因素涵盖日历位置、周期性与移动事件、趋势、价格和促销。随后通过结构化季节性约束限制调整幅度，并记录最终预测中模型、智能体和规划器各自的贡献。

Result: 该方法在五个零售、消费品及直接面向消费者的业务部署中进行了为期九个月的评估。相较于堆叠式机器学习预测，所有客户的加权平均绝对百分比误差均值降低百分之六点三，最高降低百分之十六点七；在四十五个客户—月份组合中，有三十五个组合取得最低误差。相较于统计预测，平均误差降低百分之十八点七。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在强集成预测的基础上，依据业务情境选择预测调整方案，并辅以结构约束和可审计的贡献记录，能够进一步提升预测价值。

Abstract: Strong machine-learning ensembles capture much of the trend, seasonality, and known events in demand, yet they can still understate peaks, miss moving events, or mistake temporary changes for shifts in demand level. We address this gap by framing forecast refinement as a reward-driven decision problem. For each forecast period, we let an agent choose among values already produced by the ensemble: its base forecast, distribution-free bounds, quantiles, and a bias-corrected estimate. We evaluate these choices against context-matched historical periods, accounting for calendar position, recurring and moving events, trend, price, and promotions. We then apply a structural seasonal guard to constrain adjustments and record the model, agent, and planner contributions to every published value. We evaluate our approach across five retail, consumer-goods, and direct-to-consumer deployments over nine months. Our refined forecasts reduce mean WMAPE by 6.3% compared with the stacked machine-learning forecast for every customer, with gains reaching 16.7%, and achieve the lowest error in 35 of 45 customer-months. Compared with statistical forecasts, our approach reduces mean error by 18.7%. These results demonstrate that context-aware, auditable action selection can add forecast value beyond a strong ensemble.

</details>


### [405] [One-Shot Federated Graph Learning via High-Fidelity Proxies and Transferability-Guided Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12131)
*Jia Jiang,Zihan Tan,Wenke Huang,Bin Yang,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出联邦图学习框架 FedHFT，通过提升代理图的知识保真度，并依据知识可迁移性开展个性化协作，缓解单轮通信带来的知识表达与利用不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单轮联邦图学习能够降低通信开销，但严格限制为一次传输也形成了单次传输瓶颈。客户端将私有图压缩为可共享代理时，容易损失图结构与语义信息，导致本地知识表达不足；服务器聚合代理时，又缺乏判断客户端间知识迁移潜力的能力，因而难以充分利用整合后的知识。

Method: FedHFT 从知识外化和知识整合两方面应对上述问题：通过“保真度驱动的代理精炼”尽可能保留客户端私有图中的结构与语义知识；通过“迁移性引导的个性化协作”，让服务器依据跨客户端知识的可迁移性自适应地开展协作，从而实现个性化模型更新。

Result: 论文称，在同配图与异配图上的大量实验验证了 FedHFT 的优越性。摘要未提供具体数据集、对比方法或量化指标，因此无法据此判断性能提升幅度。

Conclusion: FedHFT 针对单轮联邦图学习中的代理知识失真和聚合利用不足，分别改进客户端知识外化与服务器端协作机制。实验结果支持该框架在不同图同配特性下的有效性。

Abstract: One-shot Federated Graph Learning (OFGL) has emerged as a communication-efficient paradigm for federated graph learning under strict bandwidth constraints, compressing collaboration into a single transmission round. Nevertheless, this extreme setting suffers from a fundamental Single-Transmission Bottleneck, which limits both the quality and utility of exchanged knowledge. First, while existing methods attempt to distill private graphs into shareable proxies, their aggressive one-shot compression inherently triggers a fidelity crisis. This compression distorts local graph topology and semantics across clients, leading to externalized knowledge underexpression. Second, although the server aggregates these proxies to update global models, current integration schemes suffer from transferability agnosticism. The server cannot reliably identify cross-client collaboration potential, thus resulting in integrated knowledge underutilization. To tackle these dual challenges, we propose FedHFT, an effective One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning (OPFGL) framework that addresses this bottleneck from two perspectives, namely High-Fidelity Knowledge Externalization and Transferability-Ware Knowledge Integration. We use Fidelity-Driven Proxy Refinement to preserve client-side knowledge fidelity, and Transferability-Steered Personalized Collaboration to enable adaptive server-side collaboration. The superiority of FedHFT is validated through extensive experiments on both homophilic and heterophilic graphs. The code is available at https://github.com/Jumpy-Juice/FedHFT.

</details>


### [406] [Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12141)
*Rishabh Upadhyay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，冻结式时间序列基础模型在日内股指期货收益预测中没有表现出超越“不变预测”的增量能力；若干看似良好的指标可由随机游走结构或简单基准解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在许多基准任务上表现突出，但这种预测能力是否能转化为低信噪比的日内期货收益预测优势，尚不明确。研究旨在检验模型看似具备的预测技巧，是否真正优于简单且强有力的“不变预测”基准，并辨析常用评估指标可能造成的误导。

Method: 研究预先注册评估方案，在纳斯达克一百指数与标准普尔五百指数迷你期货上，对五种零样本模型进行比较，并另行测试一种模型。预测时距为五至一百二十分钟，输入形式包括原始价格、对数收益、波动率标准化收益及成交量时钟。研究使用仅开放一次的盲测集，并以不变预测为基准；同时采用汉森逐步优越性检验、回归排序相关分析及符号随机化检验，考察指标偏差。此外，还进行追溯性留出测试、波动率预测比较，以及含有人工植入信号的合成数据测试。

Result: 盲测中，模型、输入表示、预测时距与市场构成的全部一百六十个组合均未胜过不变预测；两类市场的汉森逐步优越性检验结果均未显示模型组合优越。追溯性留出测试中，一百二十个组合也无一胜出。改变输入表示会影响预测幅度，却不改善准确率；了解变换方式的岭回归表现相当。价格水平相关性虽超过百分之九十九点九六，但不变预测得分更高。日内排序相关指标会奖励简单的均值回归规则；随机游走下的理论协方差推导及符号随机化检验表明，约百分之九十五的观测值可由随机结构解释。某模型的五分钟波动率预测优于异方差自回归基准，却未优于其输入中已有的指数加权移动平均信息。合成信号实验显示，模型在五分钟时距只能恢复部分信号，三十分钟时距的恢复能力进一步下降。

Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型在常见基准任务上的成功，不应被视为其必然适用于日内收益预测的证据。在低信噪比场景中，必须采用严格的盲测、恰当的基准和针对指标偏差的检验，才能确认模型是否具有真正的增量预测价值。

Abstract: We ask whether the apparent forecasting skill of frozen time-series foundation models (TSFMs) on intraday index-futures returns is incremental skill. In a pre-registered evaluation on E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) and E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures, a common panel of five zero-shot models (Chronos-Bolt, Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0 and TiRex), plus separate experiments with Kronos, is compared with a no-change forecast at 5-120 minutes, using native prices, log returns, volatility-standardised returns and a volume clock as inputs. On a blind set opened once, 0 of 160 model-representation-horizon-market cells beat no-change, and a Hansen SPA test gives p = 1.000 on both markets; a later retrospective hold-out, scored as a descriptive check, gives 0 of 120. Input representations change forecast magnitude but not accuracy, and a transformation-aware ridge regression does as well. Several standard measures nevertheless suggest skill. Price-level correlation exceeds 0.9996, but no-change scores higher. Within-day RankIC across forecast origins rewards a trivial revert-to-mean rule (+0.35 at 30 minutes); we derive the expected within-day covariance under a random walk in closed form, and a sign-randomised null reproduces about 95% of the observed value. One model beats HAR for 5-minute volatility, but not the EWMA its input already contains. On strongly planted synthetic signals the models recover part of the signal at 5 minutes, and recovery deteriorates at 30 minutes. Benchmark-level success of TSFMs should therefore not be assumed to carry over to low-signal domains such as intraday returns.

</details>


### [407] [Beyond Flat Walks: Compositional Abstraction for Autoregressive Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12160)
*Kaiwen Bian,Andrew H. Yang,Yusu Wang,Ali Parviz,Gal Mishne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种分层图序列化与由粗到细的生成流程；在分子图基准上稳定提升分布与结构保真度，非分子图上的效果则取决于层级结构与目标图分布的匹配程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归图生成通常将图展平为节点—边序列，这可能掩盖大型复杂图中的高阶结构。论文旨在探索分层抽象能否更有效地呈现图结构，并明确其带来收益的条件及相关权衡。

Method: 提出将图生成拆分为图粗化、层级标记化和解码三个环节，并系统考察社区粗化、层级标记化及遍历顺序随机化三项设计因素。实验在固定模型骨干与训练方案、且训练时间匹配的条件下，覆盖五个分子图和五个非分子图基准。

Result: 基于遍历的层级表示总体上改善了分布保真度和结构保真度，但生成成本会随粗化与随机化策略显著变化。相比仅在社区内部随机化遍历顺序，在完整层级范围内随机化可显著缓解保真度与成本之间的权衡。分子图数据集均取得一致的分布和结构提升；非分子图结果则显示，提升程度取决于给定层级是否契合目标分布中的结构。

Conclusion: 层级序列化能够为自回归图生成提供有效的结构归纳方式，但其收益并非对所有图分布都相同。选择与目标结构相匹配的层级，并合理设计遍历随机化策略，是获得保真度提升并控制生成成本的关键。

Abstract: Autoregressive graph generators typically linearize graphs through flat node-edge walks, which can obscure higher-order structure in large and complex graphs. We introduce a hierarchical graph abstraction and coarse-to-fine generation pipeline that separates coarsening, tokenization, and decoding. This exposes three design axes: community coarsening, hierarchical tokenization, and order randomization. Across these axes, traversal-based hierarchy consistently improves distributional and structural fidelity, while its V.U.N.\ cost depends strongly on the coarsening and randomization policy. In particular, the fidelity--V.U.N.\ trade-off observed under within-community randomization is substantially reduced when traversal order is randomized across the full hierarchy. With a fixed backbone, training protocol, and matched training time across five molecular and five non-molecular benchmarks, hierarchical serialization yields consistent distributional and structural gains on all molecular datasets, while the non-molecular results further show that these gains depend on how well the supplied hierarchy aligns with structure in the target distribution. Together, these results characterize when and how hierarchical serialization benefits autoregressive graph generation.

</details>


### [408] [Replication of Thermal Comfort Cohort Models: No Support for Improved Thermal Preference Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12178)
*Thomas Hirsch,Katja Ceplak,Veronika Windisch,Samina Kadkhoda Masoumali,Matias Quintana,Clayton Miller,Stefano Schiavon,Gerald Schweiger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究重新评估群体舒适模型后发现，其预测效果并未优于简单基线，原研究关于模型优势的结论缺乏充分证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人舒适模型通常需要大量个体数据，群体舒适模型则尝试通过按人口统计学、心理特征或热偏好相似性对人群分组，降低数据需求。本文旨在检验此前报告的群体模型性能提升是否可靠。

Method: 研究首先审查原研究的方法，再用原始数据集之一（包含二十名参与者、持续六个月）及独立采集的数据集（包含七十二名参与者、持续四周）进行复现。模型以微平均值和宏平均值评估分类表现，并与多数类预测及依据热偏好估计分布进行随机预测的简单基线比较。

Result: 在微平均指标下，始终预测多数类别的简单基线与群体模型表现相当；在宏平均指标下，所有群体模型的中位表现均低于依据偏好分布进行随机预测的基线。方法审查还发现数据量不足、类别不平衡、缺少简单基线、交叉验证设计不充分，以及多处信息泄漏等问题。

Conclusion: 研究结果不支持群体舒适模型能够改善热偏好预测的结论；这些模型没有优于简单的类别分布基线。未来研究应改进实验设计，并控制热环境条件，以获得各类热偏好的充足观测数据。

Abstract: Cohort comfort models (CCMs) aim to overcome the extensive individual data requirements of personal comfort models (PCMs) by grouping occupants based on demographic and psychometric characteristics (cold start) or similar thermal preferences (warm start). We evaluated the validity of the reported CCM performance gains through (i) a methodological assessment of the original study, (ii) a replication using one of the two original datasets (DORN: 20 participants, 6 months) under a revised experimental protocol, and (iii) a replication using an independently collected dataset (PersonAI: 72 participants, 4 weeks). Classification performance was evaluated using F1-micro, as in the original study, and F1-macro to account for class imbalance. Under F1-micro, a trivial baseline that always outputs the majority class performed on par with cohort models. Under F1-macro, all cohort models achieved lower median scores than a simple baseline that makes random predictions based on the estimated distribution of thermal preferences. In our methodological assessment we identified the following key issues: Limited data per participant and per minority class, reliance on a metric insensitive to class imbalance, missing trivial baselines, inadequate cross validation strategy, and multiple occurrences of information leakage. Our findings challenge the original study's conclusion that CCMs improve thermal preference prediction. CCMs did not outperform simple class-distribution baselines. Future studies should improve experimental designs, including controlled thermal conditions, to obtain sufficient observations across thermal preference classes.

</details>


### [409] [Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Federated Unsupervised Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12187)
*Jian Liang,Kuangpu Guo,Ran He,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出联邦无监督识别框架，利用预训练视觉语言模型实现多客户端无标签数据的协同识别，并通过伪标签与个性化提示词应对数据异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督联邦学习主要研究聚类和自监督表征学习，对无标签场景下的视觉识别关注不足。与此同时，客户端数据分布差异会削弱协同训练效果，因此需要一种兼顾识别能力与数据异质性的方案。

Method: 该框架借助预训练视觉语言模型的零样本能力开展识别。它先估计全局伪标签分布，再通过类别感知的数据选择策略向客户端分配伪标注数据；同时引入类别权重和负伪标签机制，以缓解正伪标签的不确定性。提示词聚合方面，服务器聚合通用视觉提示词，各客户端则保留编码本地知识的个性化文本提示词。

Result: 实验显示，该方法在标签分布偏移和特征分布偏移两种数据异质性条件下，均持续优于基线方法。摘要未提供具体数据集、评价指标或提升幅度。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了面向无监督联邦视觉识别的专门框架，将伪标签分配、正负标签利用与个性化提示词协同结合，为在不共享本地数据的前提下开展分布异质场景中的视觉识别提供了新思路。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising research paradigm that enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without data sharing. To handle unlabeled data in local clients, existing unsupervised FL research has primarily focused on tasks like clustering and self-supervised representation learning, leaving the critical problem of unsupervised visual recognition largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedUR, the first framework designed for unsupervised recognition by leveraging the zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP. Specifically, FedUR addresses data heterogeneity through a pseudo-labeling mechanism with a class-aware data selection strategy. This strategy first estimates a global pseudo-label distribution, then allocates pseudo-labeled data to clients accordingly. To handle the uncertainty of conventional positive pseudo-labels, FedUR further incorporates class weights and a negative pseudo-labeling strategy. Furthermore, FedUR proposes a personalized prompt aggregation protocol where general visual prompts are aggregated on the server, and personalized text prompts encoding local knowledge are retained on clients. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedUR consistently outperforms baseline methods under both label-level and feature-level distribution shifts. We believe this work paves the way for further advances in federated unsupervised recognition. Code will be available at {github.com/tim-learn/FedUR/}}.

</details>


### [410] [An Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Stability in Network Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12219)
*Sreejonty Chakraborty,Adrita Rahman Tory,Muhammad Aminur Rahaman,Khondokar Fida Hasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，量子核分类器在网络入侵检测中的脆弱性并非单由硬件噪声造成：即使在无噪声模拟中也会出现分类器退化；其准确率、稳定性均不及梯度提升树基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常将量子核方法表现不佳归因于当代量子硬件噪声。本文通过控制实验检验这一解释，并关注平均准确率是否掩盖了分类器在不同随机种子下的严重失效。

Method: 在两个网络入侵检测数据集上开展56组量子实验，比较一个精确、无噪声的状态向量模拟后端与三个加入噪声模拟的超导量子后端。实验固定预处理、主成分分析特征、数据划分及经典基线，并评估分类指标、随机种子间波动、退化行为以及量子核格拉姆矩阵的有效秩和条件性。

Result: 梯度提升树在两个数据集上的准确率分别为98.94%和99.41%，量子核支持向量分类器分别为91.80%和82.98%。量子模型对随机种子更敏感；有八次运行退化为失效分类器，其中四次召回率崩溃、四次将所有样本判为正类。八次失效中有两次出现在无噪声后端。矩阵分析还显示，无噪声时量子核仍存在有效秩偏低和严重病态问题。

Conclusion: 硬件噪声不是分类器崩溃的必要条件，量子表示本身的数值脆弱性也可能导致失效。评估量子入侵检测系统时，仅报告平均准确率并不足够；还应报告最差表现、随机种子层面的波动、类别特定指标，并明确检测分类器退化。

Abstract: Quantum kernel methods have been proposed for network intrusion detection, yet their performance limitations are often attributed to noise in current quantum hardware. This study evaluates that assumption through a controlled analysis of Pegasos-QSVC on the NSL-KDD and ToN-IoT datasets. We perform 56 quantum experiments using one exact noiseless statevector backend and three noise-simulated superconducting backends while keeping preprocessing, PCA features, data splits, and classical baselines identical. XGBoost achieves accuracies of 98.94% on NSL-KDD and 99.41% on ToN-IoT, compared with 91.80% and 82.98% for Pegasos-QSVC. The quantum model also exhibits substantially greater seed-dependent variability. Eight runs collapse into degenerate classifiers, including four recall-collapse cases and four trivial-positive classifiers. Notably, two failures occur on the noiseless backend, demonstrating that hardware noise is not a necessary condition for classi-fier collapse. Kernel Gram matrix analysis further reveals low effective rank and severe ill-conditioning even in the absence of noise, indicating intrinsic fragility in the learned quantum representation. These results show that average accuracy alone can conceal operationally unacceptable behavior and highlight the importance of reporting worst-case performance, seed-level variability, class-specific metrics, and explicit degeneracy tests in quantum intrusion detection studies.

</details>


### [411] [A method to automatically discover symbolic local learning rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12248)
*Andrea Perin,Fabio Anselmi,Stephane Deny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自动发现局部符号学习规则的方法，旨在以各层局部损失及其梯度替代反向传播；初步实验显示，该方法能降低整体损失，并产生较稀疏、较易解释的规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向传播依赖跨层传递梯度，与局部学习机制及潜在生物学习过程存在差异，也可能带来能耗方面的限制。研究希望自动寻找适用于不同网络结构和任务的局部学习规则，减少对反向传播的依赖。

Method: 为每一层构造由局部张量变量组成的单项式字典，并据此建立多项式形式的局部损失函数。通过回归确定各单项式的权重，使各层局部损失的梯度协同降低目标整体损失。该方法旨在原则上适用于任意深度学习架构与任务。

Result: 在分类、重建和自监督学习任务的小型多层网络及精简数据集上，发现的规则均能促成层间的非平凡交互，并显著降低相应的整体损失。与基于多层感知机的替代方法相比，所发现的规则倾向于选择较稀疏的单项式组合，因此更易解释。

Conclusion: 研究展示了一条自动发现局部学习规则的途径，为减少对反向传播的依赖提供了初步依据。其潜在价值包括发展更节能的深度学习方法，以及探索具有生物学合理性的学习机制；但摘要所述实验规模较小，结论仍需在更广泛的网络和任务上验证。

Abstract: We present a general method for discovering symbolic local learning rules that can replace backpropagation, applicable, in principle, to any deep learning architecture and task. The method automatically discovers local loss functions specific to each layer by (1) constructing a dictionary of monomials of local tensor variables, inspired by Penrose diagram notation, (2) regressing over coefficients weighting these monomials to build layerwise polynomial losses whose gradients together minimize a target global loss. We test the method on classification, reconstruction, and self-supervised learning tasks with small multilayer networks and minimal datasets. Across all tasks, the discovered rules induce non-trivial interactions between layers, which lead to significant reductions in the corresponding global losses. Furthermore, the method selects sparse combinations of monomials, finding local rules that are more interpretable than those generated by MLP-based alternatives. The potential implications of our method range from energy-efficient deep learning to the discovery of biologically plausible learning mechanisms.

</details>


### [412] [Odds-Structured Distributional Regression for Interpretable Time-to-Event Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12268)
*Jakob Versnjak,Manuel Welte,Titus Kuehne,Marcus Kelm,Grégoire Montavon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种以对数优势为基础的分布回归方法，在保持预测性能的同时，让事件时间预测更易解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件发生时间预测受到观测不完整和偶然不确定性的影响，尤其是临床中的疾病进展或急性再入院，其时间取决于动态且难以观测的健康状态。虽然分布回归能够预测事件时间的概率分布，但模型输出的原始分布参数往往抽象难懂，难以对应临床风险概念，也不利于解释特征影响。

Method: 研究提出一种新的分布回归范式：将模型输出参数设计为可在对数优势尺度上相加，使其与临床风险建模中的常用概念对齐。该方法还利用逐层计算结构，支持对随时间变化的特征贡献进行稳健归因，并可适用于灵活的预后时间范围。

Result: 在两个真实世界临床队列上的验证表明，该框架的预测表现与当前先进方法相当，同时能够将分布预测结果解析为可解释的风险标记，并覆盖不同的预后时间范围。摘要未提供具体数据集、评价指标或数值结果。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，将分布回归参数构造成对数优势的加性形式，有望兼顾事件时间预测的准确性与临床可解释性，为理解不同特征如何影响不同时段的风险提供了方法。

Abstract: Time-to-event prediction is fundamentally challenged by partial observability and aleatoric uncertainty. In clinical medicine, for instance, the timing of disease progression or acute readmission is contingent on highly dynamic and largely latent health trajectories. Rather than forcing a deterministic point forecast, distributional regression offers a principled means to address this complexity by predicting a probability distribution over time. However, explaining these distributional predictions presents a key obstacle: raw distribution parameters output by the model are abstract mathematical quantities that do not align well with domain concepts. To gain interpretability, we propose a novel paradigm where output parameters are designed to be additive in log-odds---a widely established measure in clinical risk modeling. Our approach, called ODDS-DR, moves beyond technical convenience to deliver clear domain alignment as well as the layer-wise computational structure required for robust, time-dependent feature attribution. Validated across two real-world clinical cohorts, our framework matches state-of-the-art predictive performance while resolving distributional outputs into interpretable risk markers across flexible prognostic horizons.

</details>


### [413] [Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12285)
*Xingpeng Gao,Mingyue Cheng,Daoyu Wang,Huajian Zhang,Xiaoyu Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向上下文感知时间序列预测的证据驱动推理模型，通过结构化推理提取上下文中的预测证据，并据此调整预测决策，在多个领域的基准测试中提升了推理质量与预测准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型驱动的时间序列预测虽能利用上下文特征，但仅纳入这些特征并不能保证模型识别哪些信息具有预测价值，也无法确保模型理解这些信息对未来变化的暗示。因此，关键问题是如何从上下文中提取预测证据，以及何时、如何利用这些证据指导预测。

Method: 提出证据驱动推理模型，采用结构化思维链完成三个步骤：提取上下文中的预测证据、推断证据所指示的未来动态、将这些动态与预测先验进行比较并据此自适应调整预测。模型通过两阶段后训练实现：先利用多教师可控引导合成推理轨迹，并依据面向学生模型的难度指标筛选高质量样本；再通过细粒度多目标奖励优化推理与预测。同时，两个阶段均采用收敛引导的数据平衡策略，以适应不同领域的学习需求。

Result: 在多个领域的时间序列预测基准测试中，该模型取得了优于现有方法的预测表现；两阶段训练也提升了推理质量和预测准确性。摘要未提供具体数据集、指标或提升幅度。

Conclusion: 有效利用上下文进行时间序列预测，不仅需要输入上下文特征，还需要显式提取并评估其中的预测证据。该研究通过结构化推理和针对性后训练，将证据分析与预测决策相结合，验证了这一思路在跨领域预测任务中的有效性。

Abstract: LLM-driven time series forecasting has become increasingly promising by leveraging contextual features to generate future values directly or refine forecast priors. However, incorporating contextual features alone does not ensure that models can identify which features matter for forecasting and understand what they suggest about future dynamics. We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.

</details>


### [414] [The Optimal Rate Constant of Heavy-Ball Momentum on Smooth Strongly Convex Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12310)
*Marcos Hernanz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文证明，在光滑强凸函数上，经过最优调参的重球法渐近收敛速度可达梯度下降的约四倍；其最优最坏情形收敛率为 1−(8+o(1))/κ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重球法采用固定步长和固定动量，在二次函数上能够加速梯度下降，但对整个光滑强凸函数类，尚不清楚它最多能带来多大加速。论文旨在刻画该函数类上的最优最坏情形收敛速度，并厘清二次函数上的优势能否推广。

Method: 论文分别建立下界与上界。下界表明，任何参数选择都无法普遍突破相应速度：若某种调参在二次函数上快于 1−8/κ，则存在一个二维函数，使迭代呈现衰减缓慢的螺旋轨迹。上界则通过给出一组显式参数实现：动量参数接近波利亚调参，步长则显著缩小；再构造一个李雅普诺夫函数，并以精确算术验证其正定性。

Result: 在维数至少为二时，最优最坏情形收敛率可写为 1−c(κ)/κ，其中 c(κ) 在 κ 趋于无穷时趋近 8。该结果同时由适用于所有调参的下界和显式调参给出的匹配上界确立。

Conclusion: 重球法在光滑强凸函数类上的最优渐近速度，相比梯度下降约快四倍。论文还揭示了二次函数上的加速并不能直接推广至更一般的强凸函数：在二维情形中，某些参数选择会引发缓慢衰减的螺旋行为。

Abstract: The heavy-ball method with a constant step size and a constant momentum parameter accelerates gradient descent on quadratics, but no choice of the two parameters does so on the class of smooth strongly convex functions. We determine how much faster than gradient descent it can be made on this class. Writing the best worst-case rate over all tunings as $1-c(κ)/κ$, where $κ$ is the condition number, we prove that $c(κ)$ tends to $8$ in every dimension of two or more. The lower bound on the rate holds for every tuning, because a tuning that is faster than $1-8/κ$ on quadratics follows a slowly decaying spiral on some function of two variables. The matching upper bound comes from an explicit tuning, with nearly the momentum of Polyak's tuning and a step size about $\sqrtκ/8$ times smaller, and from a Lyapunov function whose positivity is verified in exact arithmetic. Optimally tuned heavy-ball is therefore asymptotically four times faster than gradient descent on this class.

</details>


### [415] [Optimal Rates for Adaptive Private $k$-PCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12419)
*Johanna Düngler,Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种联合更新整个主子空间的差分隐私随机主成分分析算法，在样本复杂度、隐私噪声适配和目标维数适用性方面改进已有方法，并消除效用保证对特征值间隙的指数级样本门槛依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有方法虽能在次高斯数据下实现关于数据维数近线性的样本复杂度，并根据数据内在随机性调整隐私噪声、适用于任意目标维数，但其样本复杂度对目标维数的依赖并非最优。此外，既有效用保证要求样本量随特征值间隙呈指数级增长，限制了方法的实际适用性。

Method: 提出非逐个特征向量消除的算法，直接联合更新整个低维主子空间。该设计保留了根据数据随机性自适应调整隐私噪声、支持任意目标维数的特点，同时优化维数相关的样本复杂度；联合更新也减少了超参数，并便于利用分块线性代数运算提升计算效率。

Result: 据摘要所述，该算法首次同时实现数据维数和目标维数上的最优样本复杂度，并保留已有方法的隐私噪声适配能力与任意目标维数适用性。它消除了效用保证中对特征值间隙的指数级最低样本量依赖，并改进谱参数依赖，在尖峰协方差模型下达到已知下界所刻画的水平。

Conclusion: 该工作以整体子空间更新替代逐个特征向量更新，在提升理论样本效率的同时，简化算法结构并改善计算效率。其主要贡献是兼顾差分隐私、目标维数适用性与最优维数依赖，并缓解了特征值间隙带来的严苛样本需求。

Abstract: Given $n$ i.i.d. random matrices $A_i \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ with common expectation $Σ$, the goal of \emph{Differentially Private Stochastic PCA} is to identify a $k$-dimensional subspace capturing the leading variance directions of $Σ$, while preserving differential privacy~(DP) for each individual sample $A_i$. \citet{dungler2025iterative} introduced \kdppca, the first algorithm to simultaneously (1) achieve sample complexity $n=\widetilde O(d)$ for sub-Gaussian data, (2) adapt its privacy noise to the intrinsic randomness of the data, and (3) extend seamlessly to any target dimension $k\le d$. However, its sample complexity has a suboptimal dependence on $k$. We propose the first algorithm that achieves optimal sample complexity in both $d$ and $k$, while retaining properties (2) and (3) of \kdppca. Additionally, prior utility guarantees require a minimum sample size with exponential dependence on the eigengap. Our method removes this dependence. It also improves the dependence on spectral parameters, matching known lower bounds for the spiked covariance model. Unlike deflation-based approaches like \kdppca, our algorithm updates the full $d\times k$ subspace jointly rather than one eigenvector at a time. This non-deflation structure simplifies the algorithm, reduces the number of hyper-parameters, and improves computational efficiency, particularly when using block linear algebra libraries.

</details>


### [416] [Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12422)
*Uros Zivanovic,Rahul Srinivasan,Roberto Trotta,Andre Scaffidi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于扩散模型的无似然贝叶斯推断方法，先用可微分模拟器构造高效提议分布，再将其校正为目标后验；在先验体积远大于真实后验时仍保持较高采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无似然贝叶斯推断在先验范围很大、后验复杂或多峰时，往往需要多轮顺序模拟，采样成本高，也可能出现先验泄漏。论文希望在有限模拟预算下，构造高效提议分布并可靠地逼近真实后验，同时改善对不同后验模式的覆盖。

Method: 方法先根据可微分模拟器给出的距离度量构造初始替代似然，并据此一次性生成高效提议分布。随后使用薛定谔桥扩散采样，从该提议分布热启动，将样本输运至由原始先验和模拟器确定的真实后验。为校正采样能量，方法训练神经似然比，且只需在提议分布覆盖的区域学习。作为变分方法，它旨在避免标准顺序后验估计中的先验泄漏；此外，还可结合良温度元动力学以促进模式覆盖和先验空间探索。

Result: 论文报告，该方法在标准模拟式贝叶斯推断基准上表现良好，尤其适用于先验体积相对真实后验较大的情形。在模拟预算严格受限的双月基准中，性能下降约百分之五。论文还将其用于受黑洞谱学启发的引力波振铃后验估计任务。

Conclusion: 该方法的核心思路是以高效替代提议分布取代其他方法的多轮顺序提议，再通过扩散式输运和似然比校正逼近目标后验。摘要所述结果表明，这一策略在先验范围大、模拟预算有限的场景中具有潜力；其在真实物理任务中的具体优势仍需结合完整实验结果评估。

Abstract: We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. To improve mode coverage we optionally utilize the well-tempered meta-dynamics framework, which also encourages exploration of the prior volume. We observe strong performance on standard SBI benchmarks, particularly when the prior volume is increased relative to the ground truth posterior, achieving a performance degradation of only $\sim5\%$ on Two Moons under a highly constrained simulation budget. Additionally, we evaluate RSBI's performance for gravitational wave ring-down posterior estimation, in a real-world physics benchmark inspired by black hole spectroscopy.

</details>


### [417] [UCB-min: Combining Bandits Under Variance Heterogeneity (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12427)
*Lilia Izri,Benoit Groz,Silviu Maniu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种逐臂自适应的置信上界算法，在未知且不均衡的奖励方差下，为每个臂选择更紧的探索奖励，并在理论分析和多类实验中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂老虎机算法的效果取决于探索策略。方差无关方法较稳健，但在奖励方差较小时界限偏松；方差感知方法可能更紧，却依赖可靠的方差估计和奖励范围假设。现实任务中的各臂方差往往未知且差异很大，奖励范围也可能难以确定，因此单一策略难以始终表现良好。

Method: 提出逐臂自适应元算法“最小上置信界”，对每个臂分别比较方差无关与方差感知的探索奖励，并选取较紧者；无需预先知道方差所属的情形，也无需对奖励进行归一化。理论分析以方差感知的方差上置信界算法为基础，研究该方法的遗憾界。

Result: 理论上，在标准探索常数下，遗憾可由两种基础算法遗憾界之和控制；采用更大的探索常数时，遗憾可在常数因子范围内由两种基础算法逐臂遗憾界的较小值控制。合成数据、教育辅导任务，以及两个群体推荐基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在不同方差情形和数据集上都能持续跟随表现较好的基础算法。

Conclusion: 该方法针对方差未知、各臂差异显著且奖励范围可能不可靠的场景，提供了一种兼顾稳健性与紧致性的自适应探索方案。理论界限与多领域实验共同支持其在异质奖励环境中的实用价值。

Abstract: Multi-armed bandits are a natural framework for many real-world sequential decision problems, from recommender systems and clinical trials to educational test recommendation and online advertising.
